title: Fusion Island Group Leader (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

The Fusion Island Group Lead is responsible for overseeing the integrated design of the complete plant system, with a focus on the fusion island, from early concept development through detailed design, licensing, and handover to construction and commissioning. The position provides both technical and organizational leadership, with overall accountability for engineering activities within the group and authority for key design and delivery decisions.


What You'll Do

  • End-to-end accountability for the fusion island design.

  • Technical Leadership & Design Authority.

  • Define and govern the overall systems design architecture, including plant configuration, major design parameters, and fundamental safety approach.

  • Lead critical design reviews, independent assessments, and design verification activities.

  • Resolve complex, cross-cutting technical issues that cannot be resolved at the engineer or discipline level.

  • Approve key engineering deliverables including system design descriptions, design basis documents, interface control documents, and safety analysis inputs.

  • Lead, manage, and develop a multidisciplinary team.

  • Define roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations for all team members.

  • Report design status, risks, and issues clearly and regularly to the VP of reactor and fuel cycle.

  • Manage design change control processes to maintain schedule and cost discipline while preserving design integrity.

Who You Are

  • Degree in engineering. M.Sc. or Ph.D. in nuclear engineering would be nice to have.

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams.

  • Deep knowledge of nuclear plant systems, safety analysis principles, and design basis development.

  • Deep knowledge of nuclear reactor physics, fusion is an advantage.

  • Mastery of nuclear plant systems.

  • Understanding of thermal-hydraulics, neutronics, mechanical analyses, I&C, and activation.

  • Experience in Manage requirements, Configuration management, Nuclear safety., RAMI, Licensing, Documentation and control, Project scheduling.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with fusion-specific systems.

  • Strong command of codes and standards.

  • Experience managing large engineering programs, including scope, schedule, budget, and risk.

  • Experience with advanced reactor designs.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. Senior Social Strategist

Company: VML

Hybrid working: Working from home / Sea Containers office, London, SE1

At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey building connected brands that drive growth for our clients. We do this by leveraging our 3 core practices; Brand experience, Customer experience and Commerce. Within these practices we offer expertise across communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.

The Role: Senior Social Strategist

We are seeking an experienced social strategist who will ideate, create, and deliver comprehensive innovative social strategies for a leading brand. You'll be keen to understand what the client needs and match that with how we can create and engage, tailored to different social platforms, and always rooted in social audience behaviours.

You will become one of the 'go-to' social guardians, helping brands take bold steps to embrace the very best of what social has to offer with our guidance. You'll have the opportunity to own workstreams and really get under the skin of what makes audiences tick. If you're passionate about social media, have a keen eye for trends & platform updates, and possess exceptional communication skills, we want to hear from you!

The VML Social team is growing and this opportunity is primed for someone that's looking to deliver best in class social, whilst learning and upskilling themselves with a team of specialists. We're very fortunate to offer our clients the full range of social expertise, from influencer managers, content creators, social account management, social data scientists, and of course…social strategists.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Leadership: Lead the development and execution of comprehensive social brand, content, and campaign strategies for [our client / client portfolio]. Leverage experience to develop broader POVs on specific audiences, trends, or best practices.
  • Collaboration: Foster strong collaborative relationships with the wider VML team outside of social, including strategy & planning, data & insights, client engagement, and creative. Integrate social-specific knowledge and align with their diverse expertise, including briefing work and working where social is part of an integrated plan.
  • Client Engagement: Steer clients through social strategies, providing guidance, challenging assumptions, and ensuring the best possible outcomes. Proactively uncover new opportunities for the brand's social execution.
  • Insights: Identify and leverage cultural and social insights relevant to the client and the social space as a whole, to inform strategic recommendations and ensure relevance for brands in social.
  • Presentation Skills: Present strategic recommendations to senior clients and internal teams in a clear, concise, and persuasive manner. Respond spontaneously to issues or questions that arise.
  • Channel Understanding: Demonstrate a truly native and broad understanding of everything social from LinkedIn to TikTok; content and trends, platform and functionality updates, and what the brand's competitors/comparators are doing in social. Share this knowledge proactively with colleagues and clients.
  • Brand Guardianship: Understand and embody the needs of the brand, matched with social, and how different aspects of the brand need to show up (from personal to business, and from more serious to more fun).

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have a proven track record of developing and implementing successful social strategies for big brands.
  • Ideally have experience of social within a related sector.
  • Be a highly collaborative team player, capable of building strong relationships with clients, internal teams, and external partners.
  • Be a strategic thinker with the ability to 'translate' and communicate complex social data and insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Be a compelling storyteller with excellent presentation and communication skills.
  • Be comfortable working in a dynamic environment and managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Be passionate about 'what's next' in social, to stay ahead of the curve.
  • Be adept at using data and analytics to measure the effectiveness of social campaigns and optimise performance.
  • Be a proactive and results-oriented individual with a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.
  • Have a nuanced perspective on social marketing built from wide-ranging experience and continuous learning, including specific insights into consumer trends, brand storytelling, and platform innovations.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Proven experience in a social strategy role within an advertising/marketing agency or client team.
  • Strong understanding of social media, with a variety of social platforms, and emerging technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Experience of working on major clients is highly beneficial although not essential.
  • A degree of some sort will help us understand your background and point of view.
  • Experience in high-value brands is a major plus!

Sound like you? Then we'd love to talk to you about this super exciting opportunity!

What's in it for you?

Aside from a generous annual leave allowance and pension allowances, you will have access to a whole host of other benefits and activities such as

title: Financial Solutions Advisor - Registration Candidate - College Station Area
description:
Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities, and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

As a Financial Solutions Advisor Stage I (FSA I), your journey begins obtaining your Securities Industry licenses, where you receive dedicated and personalized classes for your Securities Industry Essentials [SIE], Series 7 and Series 66 Exams. Once you obtain your licenses, you will be taught the foundational skills needed to be an advisor – from acquiring, building and managing client relationships to considering a client’s complex financial picture and guiding them with advice and solutions to help them live their best financial lives, all while humanizing financial interactions. Once you have reached your key milestones, you will begin working in a financial center where you will help to deliver Bank of America’s core banking, investment solutions and approach to client care. We will equip you with everything you need as you move through the stages of development.

Once you have demonstrated success as a licensed Financial Solutions Advisor Stage I, you will typically progress into the next role, Financial Solutions Advisor Stage II, where you will continue to practice the skills you’ve learned by growing and deepening relationships within a portfolio of clients. As a successful Financial Solutions Advisor Stage II, you will have the opportunity to advance in many roles within Bank of America and Merrill. The Academy will support you along the way with dedicated programs, tools, and resources throughout your career journey.

This position is subject to SAFE Act registration requirements. Pursuant to the SAFE Act requirements, all employees engaged in residential loan mortgage originations must register with the federal registry system and remain in good standing. Since your position requires SAFE Act registration, you will be required to register and to submit to the required SAFE Act background check and registration process. Failure to obtain and/or maintain SAFE Act registration may result in your immediate termination.

We’ll help you

  • Build a successful career at Bank of America through world-class training and on-boarding programs that set you up for success.

  • Get training and one-on-one coaching from Academy managers who are invested in your success.

  • Grow your business knowledge by using a defined consultative approach with clients to systematically identify client needs and appropriate solutions.

  • Earn your Security Industry Essentials (SIE), Series 7 and Series 66 licenses (63 & 65 accepted, in lieu of 66) though structured lessons and dedicated study time. You must obtain your SIE within 30 days of being hired & your Series 7 & 66 within 120 Days - a requirement for the role.

  • Build your network. Starting at a financial center, you’ll interact with banking customers, small business owners and higher net worth clients alike. You’ll be able to leverage our relationships with one out of two households in the U.S. to help eventually grow your business.

  • Provide end-to-end comprehensive advice, deliver client reviews/presentations with confidence, and recommend strategies to help clients achieve their financial goals and life priorities.

  • Collaborate with core banking and investment partners. Connect clients to the solutions we provide through Bank of America and Merrill to meet virtually all their financial needs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Aptitude in obtaining required industry licenses.

  • Must be self-disciplined in managing time and capacity.

  • Experience in cultivating client relationships, accessing needs and recommending solutions.

  • Success creating strong peer relationships through effective communication and collaboration.

title: Staff product designer
description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

To run a sustainable business, our customers need climate insights at their fingertips. That’s where great design comes in — we are building powerful software that enables the biggest companies in the world to measure their carbon footprint with ease, and drive change across their organization. Product designers at Watershed partner closely with product and engineering from vision through execution, painting the big picture and sweating the details. We’re experts in our customers goals and pain points, and drive constant iteration to get the right solution in hand to meet their needs. As designers we push each other to perfect our craft and uplevel the outcome, treasuring our weekly jams and crits. And working in sustainability, you’ll build domain expertise in one of the most critical and motivating problem spaces.

We are hiring a product designer to lead our reporting team based in London, driving our most critical platform and product investments to scale and grow our impact globally. In this role you will:

  • Lead design for our ESG reporting application, helping Watershed build a highly competitive, end-to-end reporting product and platform

  • Design and ship experiences that allow the world’s largest organizations to scale their own reporting efforts via: AI-powered multi-player report authoring, reusable metrics and answers, flexible report customization, and more

  • Drive deep discovery to uncover new product opportunities. Use customer feedback and product analytics to iterate quickly and move meaningful product and business metrics

  • Build the vision and product strategy to bring the next chapter of product to life

  • Partner closely with EPD teams to execute, and GTM to understand and build for the market

  • Leverage AI throughout your design process, as well as in the product itself to deliver great outcomes

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 5+ years experience designing software, preferably at B2B software companies or in technical/complex problem spaces

  • Have a knack for in-the-weeds systems thinking and a love for rapid, 0-1 product building

  • Have a track record shipping powerful and intuitive product experiences that customers love

  • Are proficient in design craft fundamentals — consistently demonstrating solid design process, strong interaction craft, and an eye for polish

  • Have shipped AI products, and are proficient using AI tools to aid discovery, synthesis, and design execution

  • Are customer obsessed and excited to spend time with users and prospects

  • Are enthusiastic about product and business ownership — you are excited to go deep on climate and become an expert on the market’s paths forward

  • Want to join a startup, take responsibility for the fate of the company, and move fast

  • Prior experience in the climate space is not necessary

This position will be in person in our London office 3-4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

description:
About the Role

This is a founding-level, hands-on ML engineering role at a fast-growing Series A AI startup in the Bay Area, specializing in high-quality training data, post-training data pipelines, and model evaluation for frontier AI labs and enterprises.   • Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional data and product teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with RL environments or evaluation frameworks for AI models.

description:
ABOUT AITEXEL

AiTexel Photonics is a venture-backed, stealth-mode deep-tech company in Singapore, spun out of a leading research university. We build next-generation manufacturing technology for integrated photonics — the interconnect fabric of AI compute. We are a small, senior team working on hard technology at commercial speed, with active engagement across Tier-1 industry partners, investors, and government agencies.

THE MANDATE

The CEO and CTO run a company whose week spans foundry partners, investors, university and government counterparts, legal counsel, and a growing technical team. At this stage, precision in scheduling, follow-through, and written communication is not administrative overhead — it is how a small company operates at the standard of a much larger one. You will own that precision.

This is a builder's version of the executive assistant role: the secretarial fundamentals executed flawlessly, plus real operating responsibility that expands as fast as you can carry it. Done well over 18–24 months, this seat is a direct track to an operations leadership role.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Calendars, travel, and meeting logistics for the CEO and CTO across time zones — zero-defect, always one step ahead.

  • Front-of-house for external stakeholders: scheduling and correspondence with investors, industry partners, and university and government counterparts, handled with judgment and discretion.

  • Meeting operations: agendas circulated in advance; notes and action items captured in Notion the same day; follow-ups chased to closure.

  • AI-augmented execution: build and run Claude-based workflows for drafting, meeting preparation, research summaries, and document QA. You are expected to make the leadership team measurably faster.

  • Document discipline: version control, naming conventions, and confidentiality handling for board, investor, and legal materials.

  • Visits and events: end-to-end run-of-show for partner visits, technical reviews, and off-sites.

  • Company operations support: onboarding logistics for new hires, vendor and procurement administration, and coordination with our corporate-secretarial and finance providers.

WHAT EXCELLENCE LOOKS LIKE

  • First 90 days: the CEO's and CTO's weeks run without collisions or dropped items; every meeting has notes and tracked actions within 24 hours; you have automated at least two recurring workflows with Claude.

  • By 12 months: external stakeholders treat you as a trusted, senior point of contact; you independently run defined operating processes — hiring logistics, visit programmes, reporting cadence — and your remit has visibly expanded.

title: Senior PMO Analyst - Post Trade Solutions
description:
Role Purpose

We are seeking an experienced PMO professional to support Post Trade Solutions (PTS), providing portfolio governance, financial oversight, reporting, and delivery assurance across a complex portfolio of programmes and projects.

The role is responsible for ensuring robust governance, accurate financial management, high-quality portfolio reporting, and adherence to delivery standards. Working closely with senior stakeholders, the role provides insight, transparency, and control to support effective decision making and successful portfolio delivery.

The position combines strong financial acumen with PMO best practices, ensuring portfolio data integrity, risk visibility, and governance compliance across the change lifecycle.

What You'll Be Doing

Portfolio Governance & Oversight

  • Coordinate and maintain portfolio governance activities across multiple programmes and projects.
  • Produce governance packs, dashboards, and reporting for senior management forums.
  • Ensure adherence to portfolio governance standards, methodologies, and controls.
  • Monitor project health, delivery milestones, and governance compliance.
  • Support stage gate reviews and investment approval processes.
  • Track and escalate governance actions and decisions to ensure timely resolution.
  • Provide quality assurance across programme documentation and reporting outputs.

Financial Management & Portfolio Control

  • Support portfolio budgeting, forecasting, and month-end financial processes.
  • Maintain accurate portfolio financial data within Clarity PPM and associated reporting tools.
  • Monitor budget performance and analyse variances against approved plans.
  • Track CapEx and OpEx expenditure to ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Support accruals, cost tracking, forecasting updates, and financial reconciliations.
  • Identify financial risks and opportunities and escalate where appropriate.
  • Partner with Finance teams to ensure alignment between portfolio and financial reporting.

PMO Planning & Delivery Assurance

  • Maintain integrated portfolio plans, milestones, and delivery roadmaps.
  • Monitor programme dependencies and cross-project impacts.
  • Challenge delivery plans to ensure completeness and consistency.
  • Track progress against key milestones and delivery commitments.
  • Support resource planning, capacity management, and demand tracking activities.
  • Ensure delivery reporting reflects current project status and emerging risks.

RAID Management

  • Maintain portfolio-level Risk, Assumption, Issue, and Dependency (RAID) registers.
  • Facilitate regular reviews with programme and project teams.
  • Analyse trends and identify emerging delivery risks.
  • Ensure appropriate mitigation and action plans are documented and monitored.
  • Escalate significant risks and issues through governance forums.

Data, Reporting & Clarity PPM Management

  • Act as a key user for Clarity PPM, supporting project teams with data quality and process adherence.
  • Ensure portfolio information is accurate, complete, and aligned across reporting sources.
  • Produce timely management information and portfolio insights for stakeholders.
  • Support the development of reporting improvements, standard templates, and automation opportunities.
  • Use data analysis to identify trends, risks, and performance opportunities.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build effective working relationships across PMO, Programme Management, Finance, Technology, and Business teams.
  • Support senior stakeholders with timely and accurate portfolio information.
  • Facilitate governance meetings and follow through on actions and decisions.
  • Communicate complex information clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences.

Continuous Improvement

  • Support the enhancement of PMO processes, controls, and governance frameworks.
  • Drive greater consistency in reporting and portfolio management practices.
  • Promote adoption of standard tools, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Contribute to PMO maturity initiatives and continuous improvement activities.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, efficiency, and improved reporting.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant PMO experience within change, transformation, or technology portfolios.
  • Strong understanding of portfolio governance, project lifecycle controls, and reporting.
  • Experience supporting financial management activities including budgeting, forecasting, accruals, and variance analysis.
  • Strong proficiency in:
    • Clarity PPM
    • Excel (analysis, reporting, financial tracking)
    • PowerPoint and executive reporting
    • Portfolio and project governance processes
  • Experience working within Financial Services or similarly regulated environments.
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs to tight deadlines.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Experience producing executive-level reporting and governance materials.

Curiosity and Knowledge of AI

We value team members who bring at least a foundational understanding of Artificial Intelligence, or a strong passion to grow in this space. At LSEG, we're applying AI to streamline operations, enhance decision-making, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Career Stage:

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

title: QA Supplier and Operations Engineer
description:
LTS is a leading pharmaceutical technology company that develops and manufactures innovative drug delivery systems for the pharmaceutical industry.

LTS´ commercial offering encompasses more than 20 marketed products.

LTS operates today from 5 sites: Netanya (Israel), Adrenarche (Germany), West Caldwell (NJ, USA), St. Paul (MN, USA), and Shanghai (China).

About the role

We are looking for an excellent QA Supplier and Operations Engineer to join our team in Israel.

The position is permanent, full time, hybrid.

Responsibilities:



  • Support supplier qualification, monitoring, documentation review, quality agreements, and supplier change notifications.
  • Assist with supplier-related non-conformances and SCARs, including follow-up of investigations, corrective actions, closure, and effectiveness evidence.
  • Support supplier audit activities, including preparation, documentation of findings, supplier response follow-up, and action tracking.
  • Assist with component and supplier qualification activities, including documentation collection, quality review, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Provide QA support for GMP manufacturing activities, including production quality events, deviations, NCMRs, and quality documentation review.
  • Support cleanroom quality activities, including environmental monitoring follow-up, contamination control, excursions, microbial sampling, and related documentation.
  • Review SOPs, protocols, reports, GMP records, ECOs, supplier documents, deviations, and validation-related documents under guidance.
  • Assist with ECOs, supplier changes, and process change assessments, including documentation review and implementation follow-up.
  • Collect and summarize supplier and QA operational quality data, including supplier performance, SCARs, audit findings, NCMRs, cleanroom excursions, and EM trends.
  • Support continuous improvement activities related to supplier management, investigations, documentation practices, and cleanroom/production quality processes.
  • Support internal, customer, regulatory, and supplier audits by preparing objective evidence and tracking audit-related actions.
  • Perform activities in accordance with GMP, ISO 13485, applicable regulatory requirements, LTS procedures, quality agreements, and customer requirements.

Direct Manager: QA suppliers and NC Team Leader

Job Requirements:

  • Education:
    • BSc in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Quality Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or similar – must.
    • CMQ / CQE / CQA / ASQ certification, Six Sigma certification, or relevant quality/auditor certification – advantage.
    • Master’s degree in a relevant field – advantage.



  • Job skills:
    • 0-2 years of relevant experience in supplier quality, QA operations, quality engineering, production quality support, or GMP manufacturing support in a medical device, pharmaceutical, or biotech environment – must.
    • Previous experience in the medical device or pharmaceutical industry – must.
    • Experience with supplier qualification, supplier monitoring, supplier audits, quality agreements, supplier change notifications, supplier-related non-conformances, SCARs, and supplier CAPA effectiveness assessment – strong advantage.
    • Experience with NC/NCMR handling, deviation investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA follow-up, and effectiveness verification – strong advantage.
    • Good understanding of GMP and quality system principles. Knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA QMSR/21 CFR Part 820, and applicable international standards – advantage.
    • Experience with quality documentation review, ECO support, GMP records, SOPs, protocols, reports, validation-related documentation, supplier documentation, and audit evidence preparation.
    • Ability to conduct effective root cause investigations and critically assess corrective action strategies, implementation evidence, and effectiveness as applied to both internal quality events and supplier-related SCARs.
    • Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, audit-readiness mindset, and ability to prioritize topics with potential quality, compliance, production, or customer impact.
    • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional interfaces and external suppliers.



  • Computer skills:
    • Full proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Microsoft Project.
    • Experience with SAP, QMS/eQMS systems, electronic documentation systems, or supplier management systems – advantage.



  • Language skills:
  • High-level English writing and verbal communication skills – must.
  • Fluent Hebrew – advantage.



  • Personality:

At LTS, we value collaboration, innovation, and accountability.

We're looking for individuals who can:

  • Customer Focus: Exceed internal and external customer needs.
  • Innovation: Create new opportunities with enthusiasm.
  • Accountability: Take ownership of challenges, uphold standards.
  • Leadership: Motivate and develop talents, achieving goals.

title: Learning Technology Analyst
description:
Job Title: Learning Technology Analyst

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Learning & Development / Loenbro University
Location: Dallas, TX/ Onsite
Reports to: Learning and Development Manager / Director
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary
Loenbro is seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled Learning Technology & Analytics Specialist to join our Learning and Development team at Loenbro University. This role is responsible for managing the systems that power how our organization learns, and the data that tells us whether it’s working. The Specialist will serve as the primary administrator for our learning technology platforms, including our LMS, content authoring tools, and related systems, while also owning the dashboards, reports, and analytics that enable L&D leadership to make informed decisions. This is a cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of technology, data, and people development.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as primary administrator for the organization’s LMS (e.g., Workday Learning, Cornerstone, Docebo), managing user access, course catalogues, configurations, and platform integrations.
  • Manage and support the full suite of learning tools, including content authoring platforms, and digital adoption tools.
  • Partner with IT and vendors to coordinate system upgrades, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure platform reliability and data integrity.
  • Maintain and update the Learning & Development intranet page on SharePoint, ensuring content is current, organized, and accessible to all employees.
  • Evaluate emerging learning tools and technologies and make recommendations that support departmental growth and capability.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for learner and facilitator technology questions and troubleshooting.

Reporting & Analytics
Learning Technology & Analytics Specialist

  • Own the design, build, and ongoing maintenance of L&D dashboards and reports used by department leadership and HR business partners.
  • Extract, clean, and synthesize learning data from multiple platforms into clear, actionable insights.
  • Establish and track key L&D metrics including completion rates, engagement, assessment scores, program ROI, and time-to-competency.
  • Partner with BI or analytics teams to connect learning data to broader workforce and business metrics.
  • Develop and manage recurring reporting cadences to support L&D strategy and decision-making.
  • General & Operational Support
  • Upload, organize, and maintain content within the LMS, ensuring accurate metadata, tagging, and compliance tracking.
  • Ensure data integrity across all learning platforms, including user records and completion data.
  • Support vendor management activities including renewals, contract reviews, and performance monitoring.
  • Contribute to broader L&D project work, bringing a systems and data perspective to program design and delivery efforts.
  • Ensure all learning programs and systems align with company policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience administering an enterprise LMS in a corporate environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
  • Strong data literacy—comfortable working with raw data exports, Excel/pivot tables, and translating numbers into narratives.
  • Excellent organizational and administrative skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel.

Preferred

  • Advanced education with emphasis on, workforce development, instructional technology, data analytics, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with xAPI or SCORM standards.
  • Experience integrating learning data with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, ADP).
  • Exposure to learning measurement frameworks (e.g., Kirkpatrick, Phillips ROI).
  • Background in project coordination or vendor management.
  • Experience in a construction-related or similarly complex industrial environment.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

This position is primarily office-based with moderate travel (approximately 25–30%) to Loenbro job sites, training facilities, and regional offices across the U.S. While visiting field environments, the incumbent may be exposed to industrial construction site conditions and will be expected to follow all applicable safety protocols. Must be able to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

Work Environment:

  • Indoor office setting with controlled temperature.
  • Potential visits to outdoor industrial sites with exposure to weather extremes.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Employee and dependent education benefits through Loenbro University partnerships
  • Professional development and certification support

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities. If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

  • Living with Integrity
  • Exceeding Expectations
  • Acting with Urgency
  • Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Junior Cyber Security Consultant (m/f/x)
description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organisations across Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we're over 190 FTEs and growing internationally, having secured Series C funding of 60 million.

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds, all united by one shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cyber security accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you'll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our SME clients and our partners.

About this role

We are looking for a Junior Cyber Security Consultant to join our Service Delivery (SD) team, the heart of Eye Security. In this role, you'll be part of a team that guides organisations through their security journey, helping them understand and improve their cyber posture.

You'll execute core tasks within a predefined process: onboarding new customers, supporting them with security questions, delivering periodic cyber-security reviews, and working closely with our technical experts. Your role is hands-on and focused, allowing you to develop real expertise in a structured, supportive environment whilst gradually taking on more responsibility.

Service Delivery sits at the intersection of product, operations, and customers, so you'll work across different teams and grow in multiple aspects of cyber security. This is a strong early-career role with a clear path to grow into more advanced consultant roles over time. You'll solve real problems for real customers, supported by experienced colleagues who want to see you succeed.

What you will do

  • Guide new customers through Eye's onboarding process, helping them implement EDR, cloud monitoring, and other security controls

  • Assess customer security questions and concerns, working out how Eye's resources can best support them

  • Deliver periodic security reviews, providing tailored advice and helping customers understand which measures to prioritise

  • Work closely with our Cyber Security Specialists, Product, Customer Success, Engineering, Security Operations, and Threat Intelligence teams to solve customer challenges

  • Spot opportunities to improve how Eye operates, both technically and in how we build relationships with customers

  • Learn from experienced colleagues and contribute ideas to real projects, taking ownership of well-defined deliverables

  • Support second-line technical challenges alongside our first-line support team and specialists

What you will need

  • Keen interest in cyber security. A formal qualification isn't required, but helpful if you have it

  • Basic understanding of small to medium-sized IT networks and Active Directory

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, initiative-driven attitude

  • Strong at working with customers and our partners and take on an advisory role, explaining security concepts in accessible terms

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn across different areas of security

  • Fluency in German and English; other European languages are a bonus

Nice-to-have

  • Experience or exposure to EDR platforms (Crowdstrike) or endpoint security tools

  • Basic familiarity with cloud security concepts or exposure to Azure/Microsoft cloud environments

  • Any relevant security certifications (Security+, CEH) or active study towards one

  • Track record of side projects, open-source contributions, or hands-on security learning (labs, CTFs, personal projects)

  • Experience in technical support or customer-facing technical roles

  • Background in IT networks or systems administration

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organisations across Europe from real-world cyber threats

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds

  • A key role in building an innovative product line combining effective cyber security with cyber insurance

  • A remote-friendly culture with regular meetups and annual company retreats (Spain, Portugal, Italy, Greece and beyond)

  • Flexibility in working hours (Output based)

  • On-Site Thursday socials to stay connected with your team

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days

  • Structured mentorship and clear development pathways as you grow into more senior consultant roles

  • Monthly events, a fun team culture, and real opportunities for career development as Eye scales rapidly

title: Supply Chain Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

We are seeking a Supply Chain Engineer to lead the sourcing, development, and delivery of complex engineering systems and components across our programs.

This is not a traditional procurement role. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, and supplier development, ensuring that critical components—from precision optics and vacuum systems to mechanical assemblies and control hardware—are technically viable, manufacturable, and delivered on time.

You will embed within engineering teams and take ownership of supply chain strategy as part of system delivery, not as a downstream function.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering-Aligned Supply Chain

  • Partner directly with Mechanical, Electrical, and Controls teams to define supply strategies aligned to system design.

  • Translate engineering requirements into sourcing and manufacturing plans.

  • Ensure early supplier involvement in concept and design phases.

Supplier Identification & Development

  • Identify, qualify, and develop suppliers for high-spec, first-of-a-kind components.

  • Build long-term partnerships with key vendors across Europe and globally.

  • Assess supplier technical capability, capacity, and scalability.

Technical Procurement & Delivery

  • Support procurement of complex systems (e.g. vacuum equipment, precision machining, diagnostics hardware, control systems).

  • Manage RFQs, technical bid evaluations, and supplier selection in collaboration with engineering.

  • Drive on-time delivery while maintaining technical and quality requirements.

Manufacturing & Build Strategy

  • Define make vs buy strategies in collaboration with engineering leadership.

  • Support development of manufacturing routes for bespoke components.

  • Ensure design for manufacturability (DfM) is embedded early.

Quality & Compliance

  • Establish quality expectations and inspection strategies with suppliers.

  • Support FAT/SAT processes and acceptance criteria definition.

  • Ensure traceability and documentation standards are met.

Cost & Risk Management

  • Develop cost models and challenge assumptions during design phases.

  • Identify supply chain risks (technical, schedule, single-source) and mitigate early.

  • Support budgeting and cost tracking across projects.

Program Integration

  • Work closely with Project Managers to align supply chain delivery with program milestones.

  • Provide clear visibility on lead times, risks, and delivery status.

  • Support rapid iteration cycles typical of experimental systems.

Required Experience

  • 7+ years in engineering supply chain, technical procurement, or manufacturing engineering

  • Experience sourcing complex, low-volume, high-spec systems (not commodity purchasing)

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Mechanical fabrication & machining

    • Electrical/control hardware supply

    • Precision or scientific equipment (e.g. vacuum, optics, diagnostics)

  • Proven ability to work directly with engineering teams on evolving designs

  • Experience managing suppliers across Europe and/or internationally

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in fusion, aerospace, semiconductors, lasers, or advanced R&D environments

  • Familiarity with vacuum systems, high-energy systems, or scientific instrumentation

  • Exposure to first-of-a-kind (FOAK) system delivery

  • Understanding of quality systems and inspection processes

Key Skills

  • Strong technical judgement (can challenge engineering and suppliers)

  • Ability to operate in ambiguity and evolving designs

  • Supplier negotiation and relationship management

  • Structured problem solving and risk management

  • Clear communication across engineering and commercial teams

What Success Looks Like

  • Critical components are sourced early, correctly, and without rework cycles

  • Suppliers are integrated into engineering, not reacting to finished designs

  • Lead times and risks are visible and actively managed

  • Engineering teams see supply chain as an enabler of delivery, not a blocker

Why This Role Matters

This role is central to transitioning Focused Energy from design to delivery.
Without a strong engineering-led supply chain, FOAK systems will fail on cost, schedule, and manufacturability.

title: Project Manager – Laser-Driven Radiation Source (f/m/d)
description:
Company Overview

Focused Energy is a laser-driven fusion company building technologies that can unlock clean, abundant energy. Alongside our long-term mission, we also develop near-term, high-impact applications based on compact laser-driven radiation sources that combine MeV X-rays and fast neutrons in a single system for non-destructive testing and advanced inspection.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Project Manager to lead the execution of the worlds first laser-driven radiation source prototype, bringing together multiple subsystem owners and engineering teams to deliver a research-operable prototype. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys turning complex technical development into a structured plan, enabling teams to deliver on time, and building an operational hardware system.

You will work together with the main system owners within the project make sure the right work happens at the right time, with clear interfaces, controlled changes, and strong transparency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the integrated project plan: maintain the master schedule across subsystems, dependencies, and critical path; drive recovery plans when milestones slip.

  • Lead project governance and cadence: run core meetings, maintain decisions and actions, and ensure consistent status reporting that highlights progress, blockers, and next steps.

  • Align work to the technical roadmap: ensure subsystem plans and milestones stay consistent with the program direction; surface deviations early and drive resolution.

  • Drive requirements and interface management: Ensure system-level requirements and interfaces are tracked, implemented and validated consistently and are under change control.

  • Decision traceability: Establish a way with the team to efficiently document progress and make decisions traceable.

  • Own risk and issue management: maintain a single risk register process with mitigation ownership, regular review cadence, and clear escalation paths. Steer and track the risk reduction over time to meet the project goals.

  • Budget & procurement coordination: track budget, forecasts, and changes; coordinate long-lead procurement tracking with engineering and system owners.

  • Verification & readiness: plan and guide readiness reviews with system owners (e.g., design reviews, integration readiness, commissioning readiness); ensure evidence, test plans, and acceptance criteria are captured.

  • Safety & operational readiness: ensure a research-operable safety approach is implemented (hazard reviews, procedures, training, operational envelopes) so the system is safe for researchers to use.

  • Process improvement: continuously improve delivery flow and documentation efficiency with the Project Management Office to reduce redundancy and increase execution speed, without compromising safety or quality.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience: 7+ years project/program management in complex R&D environments (hardware-heavy systems preferred: laser facilities, accelerators, aerospace, semiconductor tools, scientific infrastructure, robotics, or similar).

  • Technical Background: Understand how the system components interact and have the ability to understand the technical problems the team faces on a high level. Have at least worked 3+ years in the technical execution besides your management experience.

  • Planning discipline: strong ability to build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, work packages, dependencies, critical path) and keep teams aligned.

  • Risk & change control: proven experience running risk registers, issue management, and practical change control in dynamic R&D settings.

  • Communication: clear, concise communicator who can lead meetings, write crisp status updates, and drive action closure with senior stakeholders.

  • Operational rigor: able to support readiness/commissioning planning and ensure documentation and evidence are produced at a level that enables repeatable operation.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience managing first-of-a-kind builds, prototypes, or pilot facilities.

  • Familiarity with review gates (PDR/CDR/TRR or equivalent) and verification planning.

  • Exposure to safety-critical environments (high voltage, radiation-adjacent facilities, vacuum/laser labs, interlock systems).

  • Experience working with cross-site teams and external suppliers.

Why Join Us:

  • Mission-driven work on a technology stack at the intersection of physics, engineering, and real-world impact.

  • High ownership and visibility in a fast-moving, cross-disciplinary team.

  • Competitive compensation and participation in the company’s success (equity/ownership opportunities may be available depending on role and location).

  • A collaborative, international environment with strong learning and growth opportunities.

  • Flexible working model (role-dependent) and modern equipment and benefits.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. Join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Your Success is Our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success.

  • Vacation: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: We offer a hybrid setup, giving you the freedom to work from our office while also enjoying the flexibility to work from home up to two days a week.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a subsidized canteen.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 15% on top of your monthly contributions.

  • Equipment: Choose between a state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptop, fully equipped from day one.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s public transportation, taxis or car-sharing.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

title: AI Lead
description:
hedgehog lab has built software for twenty years. We're now building our AI practice, and we want one person to own it.

AI is changing how software gets built. We would rather shape that than watch it happen, across our client work and internally.

This is a hands-on role in our architecture function. You go into a client, listen, work out the solution, then build the early versions yourself.

You are an engineer first, who also happens to be good at organisational change and product building.

Your week splits roughly two to three days on client work, the rest on transforming how hedgehog lab runs internally.

Client work is about shaping and contributing to projects, not being locked into one build for months.

Internally, you own our AI transformation: joining up our data and systems, and making our tooling work the way it should.

Why you'd want it

You define what AI development looks like here rather than inherit someone else's playbook.

Real autonomy over the technical agenda.

Genuine variety, because no two client problems are the same, and half your week is spent reshaping how we work.

What you'll do

  • Own a portfolio of AI transformation objectives, across clients and inside the lab

  • Go into discovery, look at the problem through an AI lens, then build the early versions yourself

  • Set the technical direction and bring colleagues along, so the new ways of working stick

  • Own our internal transformation roadmap. We have around thirty AI initiatives to run across the business. You prioritise them, take ownership, and drive them to delivery on timelines the board can back

  • Move between the keyboard and the boardroom, translating between technical and business audiences

What good looks like

Six months in, you are working directly with clients, building the solutions they came to us for.

Internally, you have given the board a clear plan for our AI transformation. Initiatives are owned, timelines are set, and you are driving them to done.

What comes with the role

  • 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • 5 Impact Days for learning, innovation or volunteering

  • Flexible working environment

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Annual wellbeing budget plus 2 wellbeing days

  • Mental health support

  • Company Mac

What you'll bring

Essential. The heart of the role, and where your strongest experience needs to be:

  • Strong grasp of software engineering workflows built around gen-AI

  • Solid hands-on experience with agentic coding tools

  • You have built applications that interact with LLMs via APIs, as contributor and leader

  • A track record of embedding AI practices in a team by experimenting, guiding and supporting people

  • Technical team leadership

  • Versatile software development (Python, AWS, JavaScript/TypeScript and similar)

  • Architectural solution design

Also important. You will use these day to day, even if they are not your headline strength:

  • Organisational programme management

  • Agile delivery

  • Stakeholder reporting

  • Strategic thinking and planning

Who we are

We make digital products that help clients do what they set out to do. We do our best work when the problem is hard and the constraints are real.

We are a certified B Corp with a Flexa-certified culture, with offices in Edinburgh, Newcastle, Leeds, Manchester and London. Our work speaks for itself. You can see some of it here.

Where you'll be based

Hybrid: home, office, or a mix. We just ask that you are within 50 miles of one of our offices: Edinburgh, Newcastle, Leeds, Manchester or London.

Interested?

If you have built real things with LLMs and want to own how AI gets done across a business, we want to hear from you.

title: AI Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Your role:


We are seeking a specialist to build secure, AI-ready data pipelines and retrieval architectures that power high-performing enterprise AI agents. In this role, you will ingest, normalize, and enrich complex operational data from sources like ServiceNow, SharePoint, Confluence, Git, and monitoring tools. You will be responsible for designing advanced semantic search, vector storage, and metadata tagging strategies to optimize grounded agent performance, while maintaining strict standards for data quality, lineage, access control, and privacy.

What you will do:

  • Ingestion Pipelines: Build batch and real-time data pipelines for tickets, CMDB records, knowledge bases, and operational logs.

  • Data Normalization & Quality: Convert raw enterprise data into clean, AI-ready schemas with quality scoring, deduplication, and full metadata tracking.

  • RAG Architecture: Design chunking, embedding, indexing, and re-ranking strategies to drive high-accuracy vector search for AI agents.

  • Knowledge Mapping: Construct knowledge graphs and relationship maps across CMDB assets, applications, dependencies, and SLAs.

  • Data Governance & Security: Enforce strict access controls, sensitive data handling, retention policies, and audit logging for AI retrieval.

  • Lineage & Compliance: Maintain clear data dictionaries, transformation logic, and evidence logs for security and compliance audits.

  • Agent Integration: Build retrieval APIs and structured context packages tailored for ticket, SLA, and knowledge-focused AI agents.

  • Evaluation & Testing: Measure retrieval precision and response freshness while curating golden datasets for continuous testing and tuning.

Your Future at Kyndryl
The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Experience

  • Experience : 5+ years in data engineering or platform development, with 2+ years dedicated to supporting GenAI, RAG, search, or semantic data products (ITSM/ServiceNow experience preferred).

  • AI Agent & Data Integration: Proven ability to connect enterprise data sources to platforms like Agent Builder, configure RAG pipelines, and package governed context/APIs for AI workflows.

  • LLM & RAG Architecture: Strong background in embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, knowledge graphs, and vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Elasticsearch).

  • AI Frameworks: Hands-on familiarity with GenAI stacks and orchestration frameworks, including LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, and modern LLM endpoints.

  • Core Data Engineering: Expertise in Python, SQL, ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, and orchestration platforms like Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Airflow, or dbt.

  • Enterprise Systems & ITSM: Practical experience integrating operational data from ServiceNow (CMDB, tickets, SLAs), SharePoint, Confluence, Git, and monitoring tools.

  • Data Governance & Security: Deep understanding of enterprise data lineage, access controls, auditability, and sensitive data handling for AI usage.

  • Key Delivery Track Record: Demonstrated ability to deliver AI-ready pipelines, metadata/knowledge models, vector configurations, and retrieval performance evaluation reports.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  • Master Degree & any relevant certification


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

description:

This is a rare opportunity to join as a Founding Scientist / Co-Founder at an early-stage startup at the intersection of AI and wet-lab biology, operating within the aerospace and defense sector. You will combine hands-on biological expertise with computational thinking to shape the company's scientific strategy and core technology — bridging laboratory work with AI-driven workflows to accelerate discovery.

This role is on-site in Germany. Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany without visa sponsorship.

What You'll Do

  • Define and lead the scientific vision and research roadmap for early-stage AI + wet-lab products.

  • Design and execute key experiments in molecular biology, biochemistry, or genomics to validate models and assays.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers and ML researchers to translate experimental needs into computational requirements.

  • Implement and oversee lab automation and data pipelines to scale experiments and improve reproducibility.

  • Prototype computational tools and analyses; contribute code or notebooks integrating wet-lab data with models.

  • Mentor and recruit early scientific hires; establish laboratory best practices and safety standards.

  • Help navigate sector-specific constraints unique to aerospace and defense applications.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • PhD in Biotechnology, Genomics, Biology, or a closely related field.

  • Senior-level research experience in molecular biology, biochemistry, genomics, biotech, or equivalent industry background.

  • Demonstrated experience applying AI/ML to biological data (computational biology, bioinformatics, or similar).

  • Experience in or familiarity with aerospace or defense domains, including an understanding of sector-specific constraints.

  • Comfortable with computational thinking and coding; experience with ML is a strong plus.

  • Must be eligible to work in Germany without visa sponsorship.

Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience at AI-for-biology companies, biotech startups, or similar industry environments.

  • Hands-on lab automation experience.

  • Prior founder experience or direct experience scaling early-stage teams and operations.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with comfort navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Strong cross-functional communication and collaboration skills.

Ideal Background: Research or training at a leading institution or university, with a track record that combines rigorous wet-lab science and computational fluency. Candidates with backgrounds at defense-adjacent biotech firms or aerospace technology companies are particularly well-suited.

What You'll Be Building

You will work at the frontier of AI-accelerated biology, helping to build systems that tightly integrate machine learning models with experimental wet-lab workflows. The team values intellectual curiosity, a bias toward action, and the ability to move fluidly between the bench and the codebase.

title: Cryogenics Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Company Overview

Focused Energy is the leading laser-driven fusion company, dedicated to creating clean, limitless fusion power. We unite top scientific and engineering talent to unlock commercially viable fusion energy using proven technologies. Our goal is to drive economic growth and scientific innovation through the adoption of clean, abundant fusion energy worldwide.

Your Role

As a Cryogenics Engineer (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in designing, modeling, and optimizing advanced cryogenic thermal and fluid systems for commercial-scale fusion energy solutions. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to develop, simulate, and validate experimental designs, helping define the roadmap toward efficient and scalable clean energy.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end simulation and analysis function for cryogenic thermal and fluid systems—from problem definition through model development, validation, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead analytical approaches for new and undefined challenges, applying first-principles research to create pioneering solutions.

  • Drive model validation through close collaboration with experimental engineers, comparing simulation outputs to test data, and closing performance gaps.

  • Ensure that the Cryo team’s hardware decisions are consistently supported by robust quantitative analysis.

  • Develop integrated thermal and fluid analysis packages for commercial-scale system development, conducting optimization and sensitivity studies as needed.

  • Continuously refine analysis models as new experimental, materials, and system data become available.

  • Partner closely with hardware engineers, experimentalists, and scientists to define system requirements and deliver actionable analyses for design.

  • Provide the analytical foundation for the Cryo team’s technical roadmap, guiding what gets built, tested, and scaled.

Who You Are

  • 3–5 years’ experience (or equivalent PhD research) in integrated thermal and fluid analysis involving cryogenic systems (experience with hydrogen is preferred).

  • MSc or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Strong foundation in heat transfer, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics.

  • Proficient in thermal analysis software (e.g., Thermal Desktop, COMSOL) and able to anchor analyses to real hardware.

  • Familiarity with hydrogen systems, vacuum systems, cryogenic technologies, and phase change in solids, liquids, and gases.

  • Skilled with instrumentation, sensors, and control logic for temperature, pressure, and flow in cryogenic environments.

  • Hands-on experience with test rig construction, system debugging, and low-temperature measurements to support model validation is a plus.

  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines, and able to coordinate effectively with multiple engineering and science teams.

If you are excited about advancing clean energy and eager to make impact on a groundbreaking technology, we encourage you to apply.

description:
Who We Are

VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth.
