title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Circadia Health

Circadia Health is a growth‑stage healthcare AI company on a mission to prevent avoidable hospitalizations and transform senior‑care operations. Our Circadia Intelligence Platform combines: Contactless sensing that monitors respiration and motion with medical‑grade accuracy; native predictive models that detect 85% of preventable adverse events several days in advance; enterprise integrations that operationalize predictions directly inside EHR, care‑coordination, billing, and compliance workflows.

Today, our technology touches 40,000+ post‑acute patients daily across skilled‑nursing, home‑health, and home‑care networks. We are backed by leading healthcare and AI investors and headquartered in El Segundo, CA.

As a Full‑Stack Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining both backend APIs and frontend applications that support sensitive healthcare platforms. You will be proficient in Python for backend development and have experience with modern frontend frameworks such as ReactJS, Vue.js, or Angular. Your expertise in Test‑Driven Development (TDD), security best practices, and comprehensive documentation will ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of our mission‑critical software. Your work will directly impact patient care and enhance the efficiency of clinical staff by contributing to a platform that serves 30k+ patients daily through our Circadia Contactless Monitor (IoT devices) — a number expected to scale beyond 100k+ in the next 2 to 3 years.

Frontend Development

  • Build, develop, and maintain responsive, interactive user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue.js, Angular).
  • Implement state management and develop reusable UI components for seamless integration with backend services.
  • Optimize frontend performance using techniques such as lazy loading, code splitting, and caching.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and adherence to WCAG guidelines for accessibility.

Backend/API Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs using Python (FastAPI) to support healthcare applications.
  • Collaborate with frontend and mobile developers to integrate APIs effectively.
  • Ensure APIs are secure, scalable, and performant to handle increasing loads.

AWS Expertise

  • Build scalable applications using AWS services (Cognito, Pinpoint, IoT, MSK).
  • Expand and manage services under AWS modules while implementing robust authentication protocols.
  • Navigate Docker deployments to scale containerized applications efficiently.

Test‑Driven Development (TDD)

  • Write unit tests and integration tests using PyTest to ensure code quality and reliability.
  • Conduct code reviews and implement best practices for high coding standards.

Data Management

  • Manage patient data efficiently using databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
  • Optimize database queries for performance and scalability while ensuring data integrity.

Security and Compliance

  • Implement and maintain security measures to protect sensitive healthcare data.
  • Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, including HIPAA.
  • Regularly update and patch API endpoints to address vulnerabilities.

Documentation and Collaboration

  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for APIs, workflows, and best practices.
  • Maintain detailed change logs, version histories, and onboarding guides.
  • Advanced knowledge of Python and related frameworks (FastAPI, NumPy, Pandas, Pydantic) including multithreading and parallel design principles.
  • Understanding of AWS, including knowledge of Cognito, Pinpoint, IoT, MSK and other services.
  • Expertise in Javascript and frameworks such as ReactJS.
  • Deep understanding of user‑centered design principles, design thinking methodologies, and usability best practices.
  • Knowledge of HTTP(S) as a protocol.
  • Proficient in using and maintaining Docker containers.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design principles and best practices.
  • Experience with TDD and testing frameworks such as PyTest.

Additional Skills

  • Proficiency in C++, TypeScript (optional).
  • Experience with Qt (preferred but not required).
  • Experience with Google APIs (preferred).
  • Design Acumen: Deep understanding of user‑centered design principles, visual hierarchy, and interaction design fundamentals. Proficiency in translating complex healthcare workflows into intuitive, user‑friendly interfaces.
  • Detail‑Oriented: Responsible for developing APIs that handle sensitive healthcare data. Ability to maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail in all tasks.
  • Communication and Trust: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. Ability to maintain the highest levels of confidentiality on a consistent basis.
  • Organization and Efficiency: Capable of managing multiple projects and timelines simultaneously. Highly organized, with a keen eye for detail in all tasks and projects.
  • Growth Mindset: Ability to learn from mistakes, reflect on them, and not repeat them. Curiosity and resilience in the face of setbacks, constantly seeking to improve and grow.

Technical Stack

  • Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, C++ (Optional)
  • Frameworks: FastAPI, NumPy, Pandas, Pydantic, ReactJS
  • Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
  • Testing: PyTest
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Jenkins, CircleCI
  • Documentation: Confluence, Markdown
  • Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana

Så er det måske dig vi søger til vores specialiseret demensafsnit i Gentofte Kommune, som vores nye kollega.


37 timer 4. weekend.

Vi søger netop dig, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores engagerede og varme team på demensafsnittet, Gult team - Søndersøhave i Gentofte.

Hos os får du mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i borgernes hverdag. Vi arbejder ud fra værdierne mening, livsglæde og nærvær – og vi møder borgerne med respekt, omsorg og faglighed. Vi går meget op i ordentlighed og værner om vores arbejdsmiljø. Derfor er det vigtigt at vi hjælper hinanden i det daglige arbejde og med daglig sparring.

Vi søger en kollega, der:
  • På vores demensafsnit er ingen dage ens så det er vigtigt at du trives i en hverdag, hvor beboernes behov og dagsform sætter retningen, og møder beboere, pårørende og kolleger med fleksibilitet, nærvær, ro og respekt.
  • Brænder for arbejdet med mennesker med demens og ønsker at skabe høj livskvalitet ved at møde den enkelte beboer præcis dér, hvor borgeren er er.
  • Du bevarer roen og overblikket i en hverdag, hvor beboernes behov og dagsform sætter retningen.
  • Er fagligt engageret, tager ansvar for pleje, omsorg samt trives i rollen som fast kontaktperson for 3-4 beboere.
  • Er initiativrig, handlekraftig og bidrager med kreative løsninger og et godt arbejdsmiljø.
  • Har lyst til fagligudvikling og deler gerne din viden med kolleger, elever og studerende.
  • Har erfaring fra et demensafsnit – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
  • Kender Nexus eller har lyst til at lære systemet at kende.
  • Har en forflytningsuddannelse – eller er motiveret for at få den.
Vi tilbyder:
  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på synlig ledelse og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab.
  • Et trygt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på faglighed, hvor du aldrig står alene.
  • Hjertevarme omsorgsfulde kollegaer, som kan lide at grine sammen.
  • Et samarbejdende team med humor, støtte og sparring, med plads til forskellighed.
  • Vi ved at smil det smitter så det er vi tilhænger af.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi fokuserer på nærvær og kvalitet, med mulighed for fagligudvikling inden for demens og personcentreret omsorg.
  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring.


Søndersøhave ligger tæt på Gentofte Station.

Du kan høre lidt om os ved at klikke på linket: Velkommen til Søndersøhave


Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig - send os din ansøgning og cv.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller blot ønsker at høre nærmere, så er du velkommen til at give et kald eller komme forbi til en kop kaffe/te.

Kontakt:Afdelingsleder Sofie Sørensen, tlf. 2131 1145 for yderligere information.


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Stillingen ønskes besat snarest eller efter aftale. Ansættelsessamtaler vil foregå løbende.

Den konkrete løn fastsættes med udgangspunkt i grundlønnen for en fuldtidsstilling som sosu-hjælpere og med lønspænd på baggrund af erfaring, kompetencer og overenskomstmæssige regler for SOSU-hjælpere. Løntrin 19 svarende til 28.800 kr. pr. måned ekskl. Pension.

I Gentofte Kommune er der en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelse inden for ældreområdet skal indhentes en straffeattest. Straffeattesten rekvireres med dit samtykke fra Digital Post.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at Gentofte Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

title: Solutions Architect, Graduate Program
description:

As a new college graduate, our rotation program will team you up with experienced Solution Architects for on-the-job training as you work as part of a team supporting customers building solutions with our newest software and hardware platforms. A Solutions Architect is the first line of technical expertise between NVIDIA and our partners and customers. You will dynamically engage with developers, data scientists, scientific researchers, IT and senior leaders.

You will spend up to 16 months rotating through customer-facing teams supporting different industries such as healthcare, retail, automotive, robotics, etc. In the process, you will have the opportunity to become a specialist in our enterprise products as well as our developer software platforms such as NVIDIA AI Enterprise, CUDA-X and Omniverse. You may also be able to rotate with other departments at NVIDIA. At the end of the program, you will have become a domain specialist on at least one NVIDIA technology and will join a team as a Solution Architect in an area of your choosing.

What you will be doing:

• Engage with customers in academia and industry to understand their technical environment & challenges, design tailored NVIDIA-powered solutions that address their needs and demonstrate value, and gain hands-on field experience through customer visits and on-site engagements across EMEA.

• Be the catalyst driving the adoption and scaling of cutting-edge AI solutions by delivering hands-on workshops, demonstrations, and training sessions using NVIDIA hardware and software, empowering users to become NVIDIA champions.

description:
About the Role

A well-funded, Series A/B AI startup headquartered in Mountain View, CA — working with some of the world's top frontier AI labs — is looking for a Founding ML Research Engineer to help build and scale their AI research backbone from the ground up.

This role sits at the intersection of applied machine learning and systems engineering. It's ideal for someone who thrives in unstructured environments, loves building fast, and obsesses over model performance and data quality. You'll work directly with the founding team to prototype, experiment, and ship research-driven features that push the boundaries of cutting-edge AI systems.

The company specializes in high-quality training and post-training data, robust RL environments, and intelligent agents for frontier AI labs and enterprises — with a strong emphasis on accuracy, safety, and reliability.

No visa sponsorship is available. Candidates must have current eligibility to work in the United States.

What You'll Do

  • Design, train, and evaluate ML models including LLMs, diffusion models, and domain-specific architectures.

  • Develop scalable experimentation pipelines covering data, model, and evaluation workflows.

  • Collaborate closely with data and infrastructure teams to optimize training throughput and model quality.

  • Contribute to open research, internal benchmarks, and emerging techniques in multimodal and generative AI.

  • Rapidly prototype and productionize research insights into usable tools and production-ready models.

  • Define foundational technical culture — establish standards for research rigor, documentation, and reproducibility.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 3–10 years of hands-on experience in ML research, applied ML, or ML systems engineering.

  • Deep proficiency in Python and ML frameworks: PyTorch, JAX, and/or TensorFlow.

  • Strong hands-on experience with model architectures including Transformers, Diffusion Models, and RLHF techniques.

  • Proven experience designing and building scalable experimentation pipelines for data, model, and evaluation workflows.

  • Track record of contributing to open research, internal benchmarks, or emerging multimodal/generative AI techniques.

  • Ability to move fluidly from research papers → working prototypes → production-ready code.

  • Strong documentation habits and commitment to reproducibility.

Nice to Have:

  • Curiosity for and experience with emerging ML paradigms: multimodality, self-learning, synthetic data, agentic systems, etc.

  • Background at an AI-native startup or frontier lab environment.

  • Experience setting foundational technical culture in an early-stage team.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $220,000 – $300,000 per year, depending on experience.

  • Equity participation as a founding team member.

  • Opportunity to shape research direction and culture from the ground up.

Location

  • On-site, full-time in Mountain View, CA. Remote work is not available for this role.

  • Must have current authorization to work in the United States — no visa sponsorship provided.

title: Steward Supervisor – Stewarding – Jumeirah Jabal Omar
description:
About Jumeirah

Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

About Jumeirah Jabal Omar

Located just minutes from Masjid Al Haram, Jumeirah Jabal Omar Makkah offers a seamless blend of comfort, connectivity, and Arabian hospitality in the heart of the Holy City. Spread across four towers, the hotel features a range of dining venues, retail outlets, a gym, executive lounge and meeting spaces. Guests can enjoy views of the Grand Mosque and a culinary offering that spans Mediterranean, Persian, Middle Eastern and Southeast Asian cuisines.

About the Job

An opportunity has arisen for Steward Supervisor – Stewarding to join Jumeirah Jabal Omar.

The main duties and responsibilities of this role:

  • Supervise and coordinate stewarding operations across all shifts to ensure smooth daily workflow and service continuity.

  • Ensure all kitchen and Food & Beverage back-of-house areas consistently meet prescribed cleanliness, hygiene, and sanitation standards.

  • Monitor and enforce compliance with company policies, SOPs, Health & Safety, and environmental regulations.

  • Lead, guide, and support Team Leaders and stewarding colleagues to achieve departmental objectives and service excellence.

  • Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules for stewarding equipment in collaboration with the Engineering Department.

  • Oversee the proper and safe use of stewarding machinery and equipment, ensuring optimal performance and minimal downtime.

  • Control operational costs through effective breakage control, loss prevention, and economical use of chemicals and supplies.

  • Review inventory levels, maintain par stocks, and approve cleaning supplies and chemical requisitions before escalation.

About You

The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Stewarding operations within a hotel or hospitality environment.

  • Prior experience in a supervisory or leadership role is required.

  • Strong knowledge of stewarding operations, equipment handling, hygiene standards, and back-of-house processes.

About the Benefits

We offer an attractive salary, paid in Saudi Riyals (SAR), the local currency of the KSA.

In addition, we offer generous F&B benefits, reduced hotel rates across our properties globally, excellent leave and health care packages, flights home, and other employee benefits making the role attractive to high performers and any applicant looking for a career with one of the most luxurious brands in the hospitality industry.

Job Description:

This job is responsible for defining an architectural vision and solution that supports the strategic outcomes of the Business' Products and Services. Key responsibilities include defining the target operating environment, designing for client resiliency, assisting with solution design, and defining non-functional requirements. Job expectations include working with stakeholders and service providers aligned to the Business' strategic objectives, evaluating the impact of strategic design decisions, and contributing to the architecture roadmap.

The Document, Content & Record Services (DCRS) team is seeking an experienced Generative AI Architect to lead the design, implementation, and scaling of next-generation Document AI solutions supporting critical business processes within the financial services industry. This role will be responsible for architecting enterprise-grade AI platforms that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), document classification, intelligent data extraction, and semantic search capabilities to transform how document-centric business processes are delivered.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in software and solution architecture, Generative AI technologies, cloud-native deployment, and AI governance. They will work closely with engineering, product, infrastructure, and compliance teams to design secure, scalable, and compliant AI solutions capable of operating in a highly regulated environment.   • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and reusable AI solution designs.

  • Define integration patterns between Gen AI solutions and enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms.

  • Establish governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI controls.

  • Develop prototypes, proofs of concept (POCs), and reference architectures.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, data scientists, and infrastructure teams.

  • Optimize AI solutions for performance, cost, scalability, and reliability.

  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural oversight throughout the delivery lifecycle.

title: Researcher, Training - London
description:
About the Team

OpenAI's Training team is responsible for producing the large language models that power our research, our products, and ultimately bring us closer to AGI. Achieving this goal requires combining deep research into improving our current architecture and optimization techniques, alongside long-term bets aimed at improving the efficiency and capability of future generations of models. We are responsible for integrating these techniques and producing model artifacts used by the rest of the company, and ensuring that these models are world-class in every respect.

About the Role

As a member of the training team, you will push the frontier of LLM development for OpenAI's flagship models, enhancing intelligence, efficiency, and adding new capabilities.

Relevant interests may include areas such as architecture design, long-context and efficient attention, optimization and the science of scaling.

Ideal candidates have a deep understanding of LLM architectures, a sophisticated understanding of model inference, and a hands-on empirical approach. A good fit for this role will be equally happy coming up with a creative breakthrough, investing in strengthening a baseline, designing an eval, debugging a thorny regression, or tracking down a bottleneck.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, prototype and scale up new architectures to improve model intelligence

  • Execute and analyze experiments autonomously and collaboratively

  • Study, debug, and optimize both model performance and computational performance

  • Contribute to training and inference infrastructure

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience landing contributions to major LLM training runs

  • Can thoroughly evaluate and improve deep learning architectures in a self-directed fashion

  • Are motivated by safely deploying LLMs in the real world

  • Are well-versed in the state of the art transformer modifications for efficiency

  • Work in a way that supports performance, development, and sustainability.

The right person will be comfortable moving between client conversations, solution design, and engineering prioritisation, and will know how to turn complexity into a clear plan.

Required qualifications

title: Senior Software Engineer (Android)
description:
Position Overview: We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Android Platform Engineer to play a critical role in the development of Walt OS, the custom operating system powering our future devices. You will drive our Android system modifications, collaborate on technical specifications with our hardware partners, and oversee the integration of critical hardware domains including custom audio, networking, motion sensors, and power management.

While your primary focus is helping devices and evolving the device OS, you will also leverage your full‑stack knowledge to understand, integrate with, and contribute to our broader tech stack, including our Node.js backend services and React Native applications.

Responsibilities

  • Develop the Walt OS: Architect, implement, and continuously improve a custom Android 14+ image for our devices, optimizing heavily for rugged, frontline environments.
  • Own Core Hardware Domains: Lead the systems‑level engineering for audio routing, network stability, precision location tracking, motion detection, and aggressive power management.
  • Vendor Collaboration: Act as a key technical contact with our ODMs, reviewing implementations, troubleshooting integration issues, and ensuring hardware‑software harmony.
  • Cross‑Functional Engineering: Contribute to our scalable backend services (Node.js) and mobile applications (React Native) to ensure seamless, real‑time data sync between the device and the wider platform.
  • Strategic Execution: Make technical tradeoffs that balance the immediate goal of launching Walt 2 with the long‑term architectural health of the platform.
  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team regarding systems‑level architecture and Android platform best practices.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Languages & Systems Engineering: Expert‑level proficiency in Kotlin and Java for framework/app‑layer integration, paired with strong skills for modifying the Android native services.
  • Cross‑Stack Capability: 3+ years of experience in at least one other core area of our stack: building RESTful APIs/microservices in Node.js or developing cross‑platform mobile applications using React Native.

Hardware & Sensor Integration

Audio & Real‑Time Communication: Deep knowledge of Android's audio routing framework, enabling ultra‑low latency push‑to‑talk (PTT), noise cancellation, and STT/TTS capabilities.

Networking: Experience modifying the networking stack for seamless connectivity handoffs and robust communication in complex, high‑interference environments.

Location & Motion Services: Proven ability to integrate and optimize GPS, BLE, accelerometers, and gyroscopes for precise real‑time tracking, motion detection, and SOS/safety alerting.

Power Management: Expertise in OS‑level battery optimization, wakelock management, and profiling to ensure devices easily survive a full industrial shift.

Core Competencies

  • High Agency: Take ownership of problems and drive them to resolution with minimal supervision. Identify issues, propose solutions, and execute.
  • Fast Learner: Quickly grasp new technologies, frameworks, and domain knowledge. Comfortable diving into unfamiliar territory and becoming productive quickly.
  • Tradeoff Intelligence: Make educated decisions between time to market and technical excellence. Understand when to ship fast vs. when to invest in scalability, and articulate the rationale behind choices.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience building distributed backend systems (Node.js) and understanding load balancing, caching, and message queues.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with enterprise fleet management and closed‑system device lockdown strategies.
  • Experience developing hardware‑as‑a‑service products.
  • Hardware/ODM Collaboration: Experience working directly with overseas ODMs/OEMs to implement hardware specifications, navigate board support packages (BSPs), and integrate custom firmware.
  • Firmware Development: Strong C/C++ skills for modifying the Android Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL), JNI, and native services.
  • Android Platform/AOSP: 5+ years of deep experience modifying and building custom Android OS images (AOSP). Proven experience with Android 14 or later is highly preferred.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Employee Equity Stock Program
  • Competitive Benefits Package including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan + Company Match
  • Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
  • Paid Holidays
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Other exciting company benefits

title: Oliver Wyman – AI Engineer (m/f/d) – Quotient AI Specialist – Madrid / London
description:
Company:

Oliver Wyman

Description:

Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

Quotient — AI by Oliver Wyman brings together deep industry insight, strategic advisory, and hands-on AI delivery to help organizations move from proof to production and from production to enterprise value.

The role

WAVE is a newly created team within Quotient. It exists to accelerate AI-enabled business development and help our teams move faster, think differently, and build with reuse in mind.

As an AI Engineer, you will be one of the build engines of WAVE. You will turn briefs into working prototypes and production-ready solutions, with a focus on agent- and LLM-based work, and traditional ML where that is the right tool for the problem. This is a hands-on role for engineers who want to move quickly, make practical design decisions, and build solutions that are useful, reusable, and worth scaling.

We are hiring sevaral AI Engineers across a deliberate spread of strengths, so the team covers the full range from software engineering to data science to modern AI and agent design.

What you will do

You will help WAVE turn ideas into usable technical solutions that support business development and project execution.

You will:

  • Build AI agent and LLM-based solutions that support Bunisess Development and project execution.

  • Develop traditional ML and analytical models where they are the best fit for the problem.

  • Prototype disruptive delivery formats, including agents, avatars, and visual formats that can reduce dependence on slides and meetings.

  • Build with reuse and scale in mind, coordinating with Quotient Inside when a solution is ready to be productized.

  • Work closely with the Technical Business Partner to translate business needs into technical execution.

  • Collaborate with the Platform / Infrastructure Engineer to deploy solutions reliably and maintainably.

  • Pair with the Front-end / AI Content Creator on client-facing outputs and presentation formats where needed.

  • Join client discussions when technical credibility needs to be demonstrated or explained.

  • Help the team move quickly from experiment to delivery while keeping quality high.

Specialisation tracks

We are hiring across a spread of strengths. You do not need to fit every track, but you should be strong in one and comfortable collaborating across all three.

  • Software-engineering-leaning
    You bring strong software development fundamentals and take ownership of robustness, structure, and production quality.
  • Data-science-leaning
    You bring strong ML and analytical grounding and are closest to the data science craft.
  • Core AI / agents
    You bring depth in modern agent frameworks and LLM application patterns, with a practical understanding of what it takes to make them work in real settings.

How you will be measured

Our success is simple to state: demand for our work should outgrow our capacity. You’ll know you are succeeding when prototypes ship quickly, when partners keep coming back for more, and when more of what WAVE builds becomes reusable, scalable, and ready to deploy again.

Why join us?

You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

  • Build AI-enabled work that helps our teams win work, sharpen proposals, and move faster on important opportunities.

  • Turn promising ideas into working solutions that can support business development and project delivery.

  • Be part of a team where success is measured not only by what is built, but by whether it can be reused, scaled, and sold again.

Develop as a leader

  • Take ownership from day one in a role that sits at the centre of WAVE’s delivery engine.

  • Build credibility by making practical technical calls and helping others move quickly without losing quality.

  • Develop the confidence to lead through technical judgement, collaboration, and clear communication.

Learn without limits

  • Build a rare mix of AI engineering, product thinking, and exposure to consulting-led delivery.

  • Work closely with colleagues across Quotient and the wider firm, learning from both business and technical perspectives.

  • Deepen your understanding of how to turn modern AI capabilities into solutions that are realistic, scalable, and reusable.

Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

  • Work as part of a collaborative team that values different perspectives and practical problem solving.

  • Help shape how a new team grows, in a culture where people are encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and move quickly together.

  • Join an environment that supports inclusion, teamwork, and mutual respect.

Experience rewards that work for you

  • Enjoy a role designed for learning, visibility, and growth inside a newly created team.

  • Be part of a pilot that is built to scale, giving you exposure to how a new capability is shaped from the ground up.

  • Work in a way that supports performance, development, and sustainability.

Who can apply?

We are looking for engineers who combine strong hands-on technical skills with a pragmatic, ship-it mindset. The right person will be comfortable making consequential design calls quickly, iterating fast, and working across both engineering and business conversations.

This role is well suited to someone who wants to work at the intersection of AI engineering, consulting, productization, and delivery.

Required qualifications

  • Fluency in Python and modern AI / ML tooling across the build lifecycle.

  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM-based or ML solutions, ideally under time pressure.

  • For the data-science-leaning track: strong grounding in the mathematics of ML, including statistics and linear algebra, plus a range of modelling techniques.

  • For the software-engineering-leaning track: strong engineering practice, including testing, code hygiene, and deployment.

  • Ability to make practical design decisions quickly and keep moving.

  • Experience building solutions that are useful in real-world settings, not only in experiments.

  • Full professional English.

  • Spanish welcome.

Preferred qualifications

  • Interest or background in Banking & Financial Services.

  • Open-source contributions or compelling side projects.

  • Experience working with agent frameworks, LLM application patterns, or data / AI workloads in production.

  • Experience building solutions designed for reuse, scale, or productization.

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment with multiple concurrent priorities.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and cover letter. If shortlisted, you will be invited to meet members of the WAVE team and discuss your experience, motivation, and approach to the role.

What to expect during the interview process

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it is challenging, exciting, and fun.

We keep our process short and transparent:

Screening conversation with the team lead. Technical exercise relevant to the role, either take-home or live depending on the stage. Two to three team-fit and craft interviews, including at least one with a partner. Offer.

We assess both technical craft and the ability to work fluidly with a multidisciplinary team.

With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

title: Director of Product Management, Platform (d/f/m)
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix, Steuerbot and TaxScouts, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your opportunity:

Taxfix is reorganizing into a business unit model where each BU owns a customer segment and its P&L. It's a meaningful structural bet. It only works if the platform underneath it can keep up.

The teams that power user management, payments, operational tooling, tax infrastructure, data extraction, and global bookkeeping aren't supporting one product anymore. They're the shared foundation for every BU in the company. The risk isn't that platform teams fail to build things. It's that they build the wrong things, become bottlenecks, or let service debt slow down the BUs who depend on them.

The inner source model is already in place. Your job is to make it work at scale, with multiple BUs pulling on the same platform simultaneously, knowing the organization will route around you the moment you stop adding value.

Platform teams at Taxfix will need to increasingly surface capabilities through MCPs, APIs, and SDKs. This is an AI-native organization and the platform needs to be built like one. Not just for the products running today, but for the builders and agents running on top of it tomorrow.

You'll report directly to the Chief Product Officer and lead multiple group owners across the full platform area.

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Own the platform product strategy. Set direction for all platform teams including but not limited to user management, payments, operational tooling, tax infrastructure, data extraction, and bookkeeping. Make trade-offs visible and hold the line on what gets built vs. what BUs own themselves.

  • Run the inner source model efficiently. The model exists. Your job is to make it work at scale. Define how BUs contribute, when platform teams lead vs. enable, and how to keep velocity high without becoming a bottleneck or a free-for-all.

  • Lead service ownership across the platform. Work with engineering to enforce service ownership standards so BU AI builder teams can move fast, without carrying maintenance work that should never have been theirs.

  • Coordinate across business units. This is one of the most coordination-intensive roles in the organisation. Multiple BUs have simultaneous, sometimes competing demands on the same platform. You absorb that complexity, resolve conflicts, and keep the platform teams focused without creating queues.

  • Allocate capacity to impact. Actively manage portfolio and team sizing across multiple group owners. Know when a team is over-invested relative to BU demand and when a platform gap is costing BUs real velocity. Make the reallocation calls.

  • Build for AI-native infrastructure. Platform teams increasingly surface capabilities through MCP APIs and SDKs. You understand this architecture, have a clear POV on where it changes platform economics, and ensure the platform is set up to serve an AI-first product organisation.

  • Be the BU's partner, not their gatekeeper. Build the trust model with BU product leaders so they come to platform early, contribute clearly, and don't route around you. Your success metric is BU autonomy, not platform output.

  • Define and own platform ROI. If a platform capability isn't making BUs faster or the business more efficient, that's a prioritisation failure. Own the metrics that prove platform value and act on them when they don't.

  • Lead your group owners. High-autonomy builders working across technical, infrastructure-adjacent domains. Set the bar, give them a vision sharp enough to act on, and create the conditions where ambitious work and fast execution coexist.

Your profile:

  • You've led platform or infrastructure product at a scaling tech company and delivered results under real engineering and commercial pressure. You've owned complex, multi-stakeholder product areas and managed group owners or tech leads, not a single feature stream.

  • You've built strong technical foundations. You're credible in service ownership conversations, API strategy, and platform reliability trade-offs without needing an engineering co-pilot.

  • You're fluent in AI-native tooling: MCP, APIs, SDKs. You understand how AI-first organisations consume platform capabilities and you can set the platform up to serve them.

  • You've worked with inner source or platform-as-a-service models before and you know the difference between shipping the model and making it work efficiently.

  • You have a high coordination threshold. Multiple internal customers with competing demands is the job, not the exception. You thrive in that, you don't endure it.

  • You measure platform success in BU velocity and ROI, not feature throughput or ticket closure rate.

  • You have capacity planning instincts. You know when a team is over-invested relative to demand and you make the reallocation call without being asked.

  • You've built genuine trust with internal customers. BU leaders come to you early because it makes their work easier, not because they have to.

  • You are genuinely AI-native. You use AI in your own practice daily: workflows, coding assistants, real problems. It's a way of working, not a feature to ship.

  • You're fluent in English.

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal tech meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
description:

We're an early-stage, venture-backed AI-native healthtech startup building an intelligent operating system that empowers nurse practitioners to launch and run their own independent clinics. Our platform replaces fragmented, manual healthcare infrastructure with a single, cohesive system — so clinicians can focus on care, not paperwork.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack to build and own core product functionality across the stack. You'll design and implement the systems that power reliable clinical and operational workflows — from backend services and APIs to the frontend experiences that clinicians use every day. This role reports to the CTO.

You do not need prior healthcare or FHIR experience. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals, sound technical judgment, and the ability to ramp quickly on a complex domain.

Work arrangement: Hybrid — 3 days per week in our New York City office.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own product features across the stack using Python, Django, React, and Next.js

  • Design and implement systems behind clinical and operational workflows, including scheduling, messaging, and practice operations

  • Build APIs, application logic, and integrations with clinical and third-party systems

  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, and clinical stakeholders to turn complex workflows into intuitive software

  • Debug and resolve production issues across the frontend, backend, and infrastructure

  • Design systems that remain reliable, maintainable, and predictable as the product scales

  • Contribute to system design, technical planning, architecture discussions, and code reviews

  • Incorporate AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) into your daily development workflow

Our Stack

  • Backend: Python, Django, django-ninja, Django Channels (async-first)

  • Frontend: Next.js, React

  • Data: PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis

  • Clinical: Medplum, FHIR, WebSockets

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog, GitHub Actions

What We're Looking For

Required (5–8 years of experience):

  • Strong ability to design and own backend services and APIs — including data modeling, service architecture, scalability, and reliability

  • Frontend development experience building usable, intuitive UI/UX for real users

  • Experience with asynchronous processing and workflow design for reliable, real-world operational tasks

  • Experience building integrations and interfaces between internal and external systems to support end-to-end workflows

  • Deep commitment to reliability, correctness, and writing maintainable, testable code

  • Based in New York City and available for a hybrid work schedule (3 days/week in office)

  • Must be eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship

Nice to have:

description:
🎤 Founders Associate - a letter from the person you'd work with

Most job ads are written by no one, for everyone. I want to do this differently.

I'm Marius, Chief of Staff at voize. This role reports to me, and whoever takes it will work more closely with me than anyone else in the company. So instead of a template, here's what this job is, how I work, and how you can decide whether you'd want to work with me.

💡 What this job actually is

voize is growing fast, and fast-growing companies produce a specific kind of work: topics that matter but belong to no one. A new market needs operational groundwork. An org-wide process needs to be built. A decision needs a sharp analysis behind it. We're building a CEO Office to own exactly this work. You'd be its first hire.

I’ll be honest about the range. One week you’re working on a question that I and the rest of the management team will decide the company’s direction on. The next you're doing operational groundwork nobody will ever applaud. Both matter equally, it's the nature of building an early-stage company. If you need every task to feel glamorous, stop reading here. If "done" is your favorite word, keep going.

To make it concrete, your first months could look like this: you own the operational groundwork for one of our new markets end-to-end - research, vendor and partner setup, local operations - until things simply run. And you build one company-wide process from scratch, for example how cross-functional projects get scoped, prioritized, and tracked, and roll it out across the org. Different altitude, same job: you drive it to done.

🚀 How I work

I give trust and autonomy by default. The way I see my job as a manager: set goals you can actually reach, give you the resources to get there, unblock you when you're stuck, teach you what I know - and then get out of the way. I care about outcomes, not hours.

The flip side: you'll get a lot of freedom and little oversight. That's a gift if you work autonomously, and a problem if you don't. Autonomy doesn't mean silence, though. I expect you to ask for help early, not after something has quietly derailed.

I'm very opinionated and direct. You'll always know where you stand with me, and I expect the same back - including telling me when you think I'm wrong.

🎯 What I look for

Your background matters less than your pattern. You might come from consulting, VC, a startup, or something you built yourself. What I care about is this: you take ownership before anyone assigns it. You can be dropped into a topic you know nothing about and produce clarity within days. You hold a high bar for your own work without anyone checking. You ask a sharp question early instead of defending a wrong assumption late. And pace gives you energy instead of draining it.

If you read that and felt recognized rather than impressed - good sign.

🌱 Why voize

The care crisis is one of the most existential problems we face: fewer and fewer people caring for more and more of us. We build something that genuinely helps - over 200,000 caregivers use voize to win back time for people instead of paperwork. Purpose usually comes at the price of ambition. Not here. We combine real impact with high ambition and high speed, and that combination is rare. We raised a $50m Series A from leading investors like Balderton and HV end of last year and there is a lot ahead of us.

🤝 The deal

This job will be intense, and it will be fun. You'll get more exposure in your first year than most roles offer in five - to the CEO, me, the rest of the management team, and every part of the company. I'll invest in your growth personally. And the role isn't fixed: you'll shape it into what you want it to become.

If you read this and think this is for you, please apply no matter who you are or what background you have! I want to meet you 🫶

Marius

title: Senior Director of Product, Consumer (d/f/m)
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix, Steuerbot and TaxScouts, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your opportunity:

AI is fundamentally changing how people optimize their taxes. The playbook that built our self-filing business over the last decade won't be the one that grows it over the next five. This role exists to write the new one.

Taxfix's self-filing product is what put us on the map nearly 10 years ago, and it remains the core of our business today spanning both the Taxfix and Steuerbot brands in Germany. But the market is shifting fast: consumer expectations, competitive dynamics, and the products themselves are all being reshaped by AI.

As Director of Product for Self-Filing, you will own our core self-filing product lines. You set the product vision, lead the strategy, and drive the quality of execution across a set of high-autonomy Builder teams. You work as a duo with the Commercial leader of your business area. The Commercial leader owns the what, why, and how much. The Director of Product owns the how — the product vision, the roadmap, the craft, and the delivery.

You'll report directly to the Chief Product Officer, with full senior sponsorship to move fast and make the big calls.

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Own the product vision and roadmap. You set the product direction for self-filing in Germany and make it clear to the builders working with you, to your commercial partner, and to leadership. You make trade-offs visible and hold the line when priorities need protecting.

  • Shape the two-brand strategy. Taxfix and Steuerbot are two trusted brands serving the same market. You'll play a central role in how they evolve: where they converge and where they stay distinct.

  • Build the AI-native product. You've been applying AI as a design lens, not following the trend. You have a clear POV on where AI removes genuine cognitive load in the filing journey and where it's noise. You push the team to build experiences that weren't possible 18 months ago and to reimagine filing itself: from a once-a-year event into a year round optimization experience.

  • Grow beyond filing into wealth creation. This area is evolving from a once-a-year filing product into a broader, year-round financial relationship. You'll help shape and build the relationship to adjacent financial services that deepen value for users and give them a reason to stay with us between filing seasons.

  • Be the definitive authority on the user. You've done more user interviews than most of the team combined. You describe your users as people, not segments, and you use that to kill bad ideas early and back good ones hard. Your instincts come from direct contact, not distance.

  • Lead your Builder teams. Small, high-autonomy teams who own the full loop from idea to production. You set the bar for craft, give them a vision sharp enough to act on, and create the conditions where ambitious work and fast execution coexist. You raise the floor and push the ceiling.

  • Prioritise ruthlessly in a competitive market. This is a fiercely contested space with strong, sometimes free, alternatives. You decide what not to do as clearly as what to do, and you grow the product through focus, not by trying to do everything.

  • Push the team on experimentation. You treat experimentation as an engine of product decisions, not a nice-to-have. A/B tests, bandits, and how fast the team can run, read, and act on experiments are first-class metrics you own and push relentlessly.

  • Be the commercial partner, not the commercial owner. Your duo partner owns the P&L. Your job is to translate their ambition into a product that can deliver it and to push back clearly when the product path and the commercial ask don't align. You hold the quality bar even when the pressure is to ship faster or cut corners.

  • Own delivery transparency. What's in flight, what's at risk, what's shipping and when. If something will be late or descoped, you say so early to your teams, your partner, and upward. No surprises.

Your profile:

  • You've led product at a high-growth B2C consumer tech company and delivered results under real commercial pressure. You've owned a multi-team product area, not a single feature stream.

  • You've grown a major product line in a fiercely competitive market and you know how to decide what not to do.

  • You optimise for the company's outcome, not your org's size. You've made calls that were right for the user and the business even when they didn't maximise your own product area.

  • You've built something real users love and you can describe exactly why it worked, what metric moved, and what you'd do differently.

  • You've shipped AI products that changed user behaviour. In production, used at scale.

  • You've led people and raised the bar. People who've worked with you got better, and you can name how.

  • You believe experimentation is key to products that win. You're fluent in testing methods (A/B, bandits), you treat experimentation velocity as a metric that matters, and you make calls from evidence rather than opinion.

  • You've built a product vision from scratch and got an organization to follow it because the argument was clear, not because of authority.

  • You've made hard trade-offs visible and held the line when everything felt urgent.

  • You are genuinely AI-native. You use AI in your own practice daily with workflows, coding assistants, real product problems as a way of working.

  • You're fluent in English and German, given the primary market and the teams you'll lead.

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal tech meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

We are proud to promote wellness in the community at the local farmers market and through our community resource center with services for seniors and Spanish-speakers. Los Angeles is known for its art, rich culture, numerous sports teams and world-renowned dining. There is something for everyone in this culturally diverse city.

Job Summary:

Delivers coordinated nursing care for a patient or an assigned group of patients according to established standards of care and the nursing process. Supervises and directs the activities of various levels of assigned nursing staff, and coordinates care with other disciplines while utilizing critical thinking, professional and supervisory discretion, and independent judgment.

Essential Functions:

Evaluates progress toward attaining outcomes. Identifies outcomes for the patient or the patient’s situation.

title: Enterprise Cloud Architect
description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit .

Role Overview:

CHAOS Industries is hiring a Enterprise Cloud Architect to design, lead, and govern our cloud infrastructure strategy across defense and GovCon program environments. This is a high-impact, senior individual contributor role that sits at the center of our digital transformation — you'll define how we build, secure, and scale cloud capabilities across classified, unclassified, and hybrid environments. You'll own the architecture from concept through delivery, working alongside ISSMs, program managers, and engineering teams to ensure every solution is mission-ready, compliant, and built to last.

  • You'll be embedded across the Enterprise Technology and Classified Programs divisions — partnering with ISSMs, security engineers, program leads, and government customers to translate mission requirements into cloud architecture that actually works at scale in a defense environment. If you thrive in environments where the stakes are real, this is your seat.
  • From day one, you'll own the cloud architecture roadmap, lead our AWS GovCloud and Azure Government platform strategy, drive zero trust network architecture implementation, and architect the secure connectivity fabric between classified and unclassified environments. You build the things other architects only diagram.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and own the enterprise cloud architecture across AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, and on-premise/hybrid environments supporting classified and unclassified program workloads.
  • Develop cloud architecture documentation including solution design documents, network diagrams, data flow maps, and Authority to Operate (ATO) supporting artifacts aligned to NIST RMF, ICD 503, and FedRAMP.
  • Define and enforce cloud security architecture standards including Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), identity and access management (IAM), encryption in transit and at rest, and workload isolation patterns.
  • Lead cloud migration planning and execution — assess on-premise workloads, define migration strategies (rehost, replatform, refactor), and oversee technical delivery.
  • Architect secure, high-availability cloud network topologies including VPC/VNET design, transit gateways, private connectivity (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute), and cross-domain solution integration.
  • Collaborate with ISSM/ISSO teams to develop and maintain Cloud Security Plans, System Security Plans (SSPs), and continuous monitoring strategies for cloud-hosted systems.
  • Establish infrastructure-as-code (IaC) standards and patterns using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Azure Bicep; promote repeatable, auditable, and secure deployment pipelines.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud technologies, services, and vendors; provide build vs. buy vs. configure recommendations with documented trade studies for CIO and executive review.
  • Serve as the primary technical authority for cloud architecture on assigned programs; engage directly with government customers, AOs, and prime contractors on cloud-related matters.
  • Mentor and guide cloud engineers, DevSecOps practitioners, and junior architects; establish architecture review processes and cloud governance frameworks.
  • Travel up to 10% CONUS to support program sites, government customer engagements, and architecture reviews.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cloud Computing, or a related technical field. Master's degree preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • 8–12 years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, or solutions architecture, with a minimum of 4 years designing cloud solutions for DoD, IC, or federal government programs.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting production workloads on AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government, including multi-account/multi-subscription landing zone design, networking, and IAM.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or equivalent) and CI/CD pipeline security (DevSecOps).
  • Working knowledge of FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-144, CMMC Level 2/3, and DFARS cloud security requirements.
  • Experience supporting NIST RMF authorization activities for cloud-hosted systems, including development of cloud-specific SSP artifacts and continuous monitoring strategies.
  • Active Secret clearance required at time of hire. TS/SCI eligibility strongly preferred; specific program assignments may require upgrade.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Active Secret Clearance
  • Experience designing Cross Domain Solutions (CDS) or multi-level security (MLS) architectures for classified environments.
  • Familiarity with NSA/CSS cloud security standards, DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (CC SRG), or IC cloud policy.
  • Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, EKS, AKS) and service mesh architectures in a GovCloud environment.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native SIEM and security tooling (AWS Security Hub, Microsoft Sentinel, Crowdstrike Falcon) for continuous monitoring in classified/CUI environments.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent.
  • TOGAF 9/10 or equivalent enterprise architecture certification.

Why CHAOS?

  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
  • Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
  • Our Perks: Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code
  • Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
  • Team Growth: 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $180,000 - $220,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

title: ACCOUNT REPRESENTATIVE (6070)
description:

title: Founding Product Engineer
description:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 3 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

What you will do

Melotech is starting something new. On top of everything we have already shipped, we are building a brand-new consumer product from zero, and you are its founding product hire. There is no product yet, so you own what we build and why. You will define, prototype and ship the first version from a blank page, then own the loops that turn a first-time user into a daily one. Working fully autonomously alongside our founder, your product bets directly decide whether people come back. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Defining and shipping v1 of a new consumer product from scratch, prototyping fast and cutting anything that doesn't earn its place

  • Owning the product end to end, from user research to shipped features, across the full stack of the experience

  • Living in the numbers: retention, DAU and the engagement loops that shape our trajectory

  • Running user interviews constantly and turning what you hear into product people love

  • Building with AI as a default primitive, not a bolt-on, using modern tools to go from idea to production-ready MVP at lightspeed

  • Making bold product calls and creative bets that shape our roadmap and our company

Who you are

We're looking for a builder who happens to be a product person, or a product person who can build. You've shipped consumer product that real people used and came back to, and you know exactly why they did.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

  • 3 or more years of experience, with real time as an engineer or working shoulder to shoulder with engineering

  • You've built and launched a B2C product at genuine engagement, ideally in music, media or streaming, though any high-engagement consumer product counts

  • You understand what locks users in: retention, engagement loops, habit formation

  • Equal parts user-obsessed and numbers-driven. You run the interviews and you decide off the data, and you need both

  • AI-native, with AI woven through how you research, design and build

  • You come from an early-stage, high-growth consumer company, or you started one yourself. You think like a founder because you have been early before

  • You thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

  • You're obsessed with music, video or social media

What makes this exciting

You are one of the first people on a brand-new product, inside an ambitious team that is changing the world of media and entertainment. Being this early means every decision you make shapes its trajectory. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

  1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call - getting to know you

  2. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion - present and debate your skills

  3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO - going deep on all topics

  4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding


Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.
