title: AI Deployment Engineer - Startups
description:
About the team

The AI Deployment Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior.

This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems.

About the role

We are seeking a technically proficient, product-minded engineer to help push the frontier of advanced AI with our strategic startup customers. You'll work with some of the most exciting AI startups in the world, helping them optimize their own systems and turning those learnings into durable improvements across OpenAI’s research and products. You will partner deeply on complex workflows, identify the gaps that matter, and help transform those gaps into reproducible evaluations, technical insights - helping shape OpenAI's research and product direction.

This role is well suited to engineers who are equally comfortable debugging a workflow, iterating on prompts or agents, designing evaluations, and collaborating across research and product. You should be excited by ambiguous, high-impact problems and motivated by the opportunity to shape how advanced AI systems improve in practice.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance.

In this role, you will:

  • Work directly with strategic startup customers to understand critical workflows, uncover failure modes, and identify high-impact opportunities for improvement.

  • Prototype and iterate on prompts, agents, and workflow designs to better understand system behavior and unlock customer value.

  • Synthesize and deliver valuable feedback to the Product and Research teams, turning real usage patterns into clear, reproducible evals, benchmarks, and technical artifacts that improve model and product quality and ensure customer-grounded learnings influence roadmap and model development.

  • Build repeatable tools, patterns, and evaluation approaches that raise the quality bar across multiple use cases.

  • Operate with strong judgment in ambiguous environments, balancing immediate technical problem-solving with longer-term system improvement.

  • Build relationships within the startup ecosystem, serving as a technical partner to both individual customers and the broader community.

Our success is simple to state: demand for our work should outgrow our capacity. You’ll know you are succeeding when prototypes ship quickly, when partners keep coming back for more, and when more of what WAVE builds becomes reusable, scalable, and ready to deploy again.

Why join us?

You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

This role is well suited to someone who wants to work at the intersection of AI engineering, consulting, productization, and delivery.

As our AI Automation Engineer, you will be the driving force behind scaling efficiency at Cosuno. As the expert for Cosuno’s automation stack, you will partner with teams across the company to identify, design, and implement AI-driven workflows that transform their work. Rather than building or training proprietary models from scratch, you will leverage state-of-the-art existing models and reasoning chains to solve business problems.

As part of the product team, you will collaborate closely with the CEO & CTO to ensure all solutions are technically sound and aligned with our core infrastructure. This is an execution-heavy role where success is measured by the speed and reliability of the modular automation platform you build.

Key responsibilities

  • Discovery & Prioritization: Partner with Finance, Sales, Ops & Product to identify high-ROI automation opportunities & evaluate them based on business impact versus technical effort.

  • Workflow Engineering: Design, prototype, and deploy end-to-end AI workflows by building our orchestration stack (e.g., n8n, Vector Databases) and connecting various endpoints via APIs to build a universal memory for Cosuno.

  • Scaling & Modularity: Build solutions that are modular and reusable across different departments to avoid "reinventing the wheel" for every new request.

  • Enablement & Governance: Establish AI guardrails, while enabling AI champions in other departments to work with the automations themselves.

  • Monitoring & Optimization: Define and track success metrics (ROI, time saved, reliability) to ensure automations deliver continuous value.

Your profile

  • The "Product" Mindset: You treat internal tools like products. You prioritize ruthlessly and focus on business value over "perfect code” or "beautiful UI”.

  • Technical Fluency: You are proficient in Python, n8n, and API architecture. You have hands-on experience with RAG and connecting LLMs to proprietary data sources.

  • Applied AI Focus: You prefer building “Reasoning Chains” and integrating existing tools over training custom models.

  • Systems Thinker: You see the company as a series of interconnected data flows. You naturally see patterns and build modular solutions that scale across teams.

  • Change Agent: You have experience driving organizational change and can explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders with ease.

  • Pragmatic Innovator: You would rather ship a working automation in two weeks than a perfect one in six months, and you have the commercial sense to block non-feasible requests.

Why us

  • Applied AI, Not R&D: You won’t spend months training models that never go live. You’ll leverage the modern stack (LLMs, Vector DBs, n8n) to ship high-impact automations that solve real business problems immediately.

  • Uncapped Leverage: Construction is one of the last undigitized global industries. We aren't optimizing ad-clicks; we are building the digital nervous system for the physical world. Your efficiency gains here have a massive multiplier effect.

  • Strategic Ownership: You aren’t hidden in a silo. Collaborating directly with the CEO & CTO, you have the autonomy to identify bottlenecks and build the infrastructure that allows Cosuno to scale.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

title: Director Asset Backed Financing
description:
Who We Are

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview

As Sereact scales, financing our robotics deployments becomes a strategic capability in its own right. We are looking for a Director Asset-Backed Financing based in Stuttgart to build our ABF program from zero—incorporating the SPV, designing the structure, raising the debt, and running the vehicle long-term. This is a true founder-style mandate inside Finance: you start with a blank page, a supportive Board, and Tier 1 investors, and you own the program end-to-end.

Your Responsibilities:

Program Design & SPV Setup

  • Design Sereact's asset-backed financing program from the ground up—asset class definition, eligibility, structure, jurisdiction, tax and accounting treatment.

Incorporate the SPV(s):

  • select jurisdiction, engage corporate services providers, set up governance, bank accounts, and the operational infrastructure required to run a financing vehicle.

  • Work with external counsel, tax advisors, and auditors to put the legal and accounting architecture in place—true-sale opinions, security packages, servicing arrangements.

Fundraising for the SPV

  • Own the debt fundraising process end-to-end: build the lender universe, prepare the data room, run the process, negotiate term sheets, and drive transactions to close.

  • Engage banks, private credit funds, and alternative lenders—starting with a first warehouse or seed facility and progressing to larger or syndicated structures over time.

  • Build and maintain ongoing relationships with debt capital providers as a repeatable funding channel.

Structuring & Modeling

  • Build the cash flow models, waterfalls, and capital structure analyses that underpin every facility.

  • Define and negotiate advance rates, eligibility criteria, concentration limits, covenants, triggers, and reserve mechanics.

  • Pressure-test structures against downside scenarios and ensure the vehicle remains robust as the asset pool scales.

Running the Vehicle

  • Stand up the operational backbone of the SPV: borrowing base calculations, lender reporting, compliance certificates, servicer reports, audit trails.

  • Own data quality end-to-end—from the operating company's source systems to the data tape that lenders see each month.

  • Manage amendments, waivers, upsizes, and refinancings as the program matures.

Strategic Partnership

  • Partner with the CEO, Director Finance, and Commercial leadership to align the financing program with commercial models such as Robotics-as-a-Service, equipment leasing, or customer financing.

  • Advise on contract design, pricing, and unit economics where financing structures create constraints or unlock new offerings.

  • Brief the Board and equity investors on the program—capacity, cost of capital, and the trade-off between dilutive and non-dilutive funding.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, or a related field with a focus on Finance.

  • 5+ years of practical experience in structured finance, securitization, asset-based lending, or private credit, ideally a mix of originating-side (investment bank, structured finance desk, debt fund) and borrower-side (corporate treasury or finance team that has closed an ABF facility).

  • Demonstrable track record of taking at least one asset-backed structure from concept to close. Experience financing hardware, equipment, or recurring-revenue contracts is a strong plus.

Soft Skills

  • A builder's mindset with high ownership—energized by a blank page and willing to do the unglamorous setup work alongside the strategic negotiation.

  • Strong commercial judgment and a pragmatic approach to structuring in a technology-driven environment.

  • Excellent communication skills—able to translate structured finance concepts for Founders, engineers, and Board members alike.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English (German optional).

Our interview plan:

  • Application

  • Take‑home assignment: A short structuring case with clear instructions and a deadline—size a facility for a hypothetical asset pool, propose a structure, flag the key risks.

title: Energy Markets Consultant/Senior Energy Markets Consultant
description:
Energy Markets Consultant / Senior Consultant

U.S. Remote (Reston, VA preferred)

About ICF

ICF helps clients navigate the rapidly evolving energy landscape through market analysis, forecasting, transaction support, strategic advisory services, and regulatory expertise. Our clients include power plant developers, utilities, infrastructure investors, lenders, private equity firms, technology companies, government agencies, and other stakeholders shaping the future of the energy industry.

ICF's Power Markets team supports investment decisions, asset development, mergers and acquisitions, resource planning, and policy evaluation across all major U.S. power markets, including ERCOT, PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, MISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, and SERC.

About the Role

ICF is seeking an Energy Markets Consultant / Senior Consultant to join our growing Power Markets practice. In this role, you will work with leading energy industry participants to evaluate investment opportunities, forecast market outcomes, assess risks, and develop strategies in an increasingly complex energy environment.

You will contribute to projects involving power market forecasting, asset valuation, transmission and interconnection analysis, renewable energy development, battery energy storage systems (BESS), resource adequacy, data center load growth, and energy transition initiatives.

Working alongside experienced industry professionals, you will gain exposure to a broad range of technical, financial, and strategic issues affecting U.S. electricity markets while developing expertise that directly influences major investment and business decisions.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Perform quantitative, economic, and technical analyses of U.S. power markets using commercial market models, proprietary tools, and large datasets.

  • Develop long-term forecasts of energy, capacity, ancillary service, and renewable energy market outcomes.

  • Evaluate renewable energy, battery storage, conventional generation, transmission, and emerging energy investments.

  • Analyze market fundamentals including load growth, fuel prices, transmission congestion, generation retirements, policy changes, and new resource additions.

  • Support interconnection and transmission analyses, including assessments of queue activity, network upgrade costs, congestion impacts, and project economics.

  • Assist with asset valuations, project financing analyses, acquisition due diligence, and M&A support engagements.

  • Collaborate with colleagues to enhance ICF's proprietary forecasting methodologies, databases, and analytical tools.

  • Prepare client presentations, technical reports, and market insights that effectively communicate complex findings to diverse audiences.

  • Support business development initiatives through market research, proposal preparation, conference participation, and thought leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

Consultant

  • Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance, Operations Research, Mathematics, Energy Systems, Statistics, or a related quantitative field

    • Bachelor’s degree AND 2 to 4+ years of experience in energy markets, power systems, energy economics, market analysis, consulting, trading, utility planning, or a related field

    • Master’s degree AND 1 to 3+ years of experience in energy markets, power systems, energy economics, market analysis, consulting, trading, utility planning, or a related field

  • Analytical and problem-solving skill experience

  • Experience using Excel and quantitative analysis tools

  • Experience with Python, R, SQL, or similar programming languages

Senior Consultant

    • Bachelor’s degree AND 5 to 8+ years of experience in energy markets, power systems, energy economics, market analysis, consulting, trading, utility planning, or a related field

    • Master’s degree AND 4 to 7+ years of experience in energy markets, power systems, energy economics, market analysis, consulting, trading, utility planning, or a related field

  • Analytical and problem-solving skill experience

  • Experience using Excel and quantitative analysis tools

  • Experience with Python, R, SQL, or similar programming languages

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with power market simulation and forecasting tools such as PROMOD®, PLEXOS®, Aurora®, PSLF®, or similar platforms

  • Understanding of U.S. wholesale power markets, market design, transmission systems, resource adequacy, and generation economics

  • Experience supporting renewable energy, battery storage, transmission, utility, or infrastructure investment projects

  • Knowledge of asset valuation, project finance, M&A due diligence, or investment analysis

  • Experience using Python, R, SQL, Power BI, or other advanced analytical tools

  • Experience leveraging artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, generative AI, and AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to improve market analysis, research, forecasting, data processing, automation, and client deliverables

  • Interest in emerging topics including energy transition, data center load growth, electrification, battery storage, transmission expansion, and grid modernization

Professional Skills

  • Strong organizational and project management skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Intellectual curiosity and desire to continuously learn about energy markets and emerging technologies

  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within multidisciplinary teams

  • Strong attention to detail, initiative, and commitment to client service

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

title: [LTA-TRO] SOFTWARE ENGINEER – TRAFFIC LIGHT MGMT & SENSORS
description:
[What the role is]

The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is looking for passionate engineers to build the future of Singapore’s urban mobility. You will join a team dedicated to modernizing our critical national infrastructure, ensuring our traffic control systems are smarter, safer, and more resilient.

[What you will be working on]

You will be at the forefront of developing the Next Generation Traffic Light Control System. This is a mission-critical project focused on optimizing traffic flow and enhancing road safety across the island.

  • ​Production-Grade Development: Design and build modular, high-performance software components meant for real-world production systems. You will use C++ for real-time, resource-constrained control logic and Python for system automation, data processing, and integration layers. You may also be participating in web applications development if assessed to have the relevant experience.
  • ​Rigorous Software QA: You will be responsible for the end-to-end quality of your code. This includes writing comprehensive unit tests, performing integration testing in simulated traffic environments, and ensuring that software meets the high-reliability standards required for 24/7 operations. ​
  • Edge-to-Cloud Readiness: While current deployments are local/on-premise for security and latency, you will architect modules with a "cloud-ready" mindset (e.g., containerization-friendly, decoupled services), ensuring seamless integration for future cloud transitions. ​
  • Critical Infrastructure Security: Implement robust security protocols to protect national infrastructure. You’ll ensure that the programming approach adhere to "Security by Design" principles. ​
  • Continuous Learning: You will constantly explore new technologies, system architectures, and security practices. You’ll collaborate with diverse teams across the government to integrate cross-agency innovations.

[What we are looking for]

We value strong engineering fundamentals and a "production-first" mindset. We are looking for individuals (1–3 years of experience, or fresh graduates who demonstrate exceptional aptitude) who possess:

​​Strong Programming Foundation in one or more of the following:

  • Proficiency in C++ for performance-critical applications, with a focus on memory safety and concurrency.

  • ​Proficiency in Python for building robust internal tools and system modules.

  • Proficiency in in Java for web-based applications development

​Commitment to Quality (QA): Experience with, or a strong understanding of, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and debugging tools. You believe that code isn't "done" until it is thoroughly tested and documented. ​

Engineering Excellence: A proven ability to build high-quality, secure, and maintainable software. You should be comfortable working within Linux-based environments and maintaining high standards in version control. ​Analytical Thinking: The ability to think clearly about abstract problems. You should have strong debugging skills—whether it's tracing a race condition in C++ or validating a logic flow in Python. ​

Collaborative Mindset: Effective communication is key. You will work closely with fellow engineers, policy officers, UX designers, cybersecurity specialists, and various partner agencies. ​

Proactive Initiative: You drive improvements in reliability and security autonomously. You take pride in ensuring that the software governing our roads is failsafe.

​Public Service Spirit: You care deeply about the public good and understand the responsibility of working on critical national infrastructure that impacts millions of lives daily

As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.

Job Summary

  • The Nuclear Medicine technologist assists with providing safe, age appropriate care to the patient by performing all exams provided by the department per department procedures.
  • The technologist has the knowledge and ability to properly and safely obtain a quality diagnostic study.
  • He/she is responsible for performing a wide variety of technical procedures requiring independent judgment, ingenuity and initiative in the utilization of the equipment for the diagnosis and/or treatment of diseases.

  • He/she sets up the equipment to provide imaging service and positions patient for the procedure.

Education

  • Associates Radiologic Technology

Experience

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a clinical setting caring for patients (may include clinical rotations) is required
  • Minimum 1 year of Nuclear medicine experience is preferred

Certifications

  • All certifications are required upon hire unless otherwise stated.
  • ARRT Nuclear Technology or Cert Nuclear Med Tech
  • Basic Life Support or BLS - Instructor

Core Responsibilities

Equipment

  • Demonstrates the ability to adjust technique so that patient receives the best study possible and that image quality is maintained.
  • Reports problems regarding malfunctioning equipment to supervisor or service provider, so that problem can be corrected in a timely manner.
  • Cleans, disinfects and maintains equipment in accordance with infection control policy and department cleaning schedule.

Patient Care

  • Verifies proper clinician order for procedure.
  • Obtains complete clinical history, gathers examination data and assesses for contraindicating conditions.
  • Follows established procedures for the administration of radiopharmaceuticals so that no patient condition deteriorates, and no patient suffers undue pain, due to error or poor technique.
  • Ensures that all studies have proper patient identification and right and left marker are utilized appropriately.
  • Reviews images for clinically acceptable results and releases patients.
  • Responds to emergency situations and provides for the restocking of the crash cart and maintenance of life support equipment.
  • Assists other technologists in all modalities when needed.
  • Observes patient condition and properly evaluates situations when physician intervention is necessary so that no patient condition deteriorates.
  • Verifies correct identity of patient using 2 unique identifiers prior to performing a procedure per hospital policy and procedure.
  • Ensures patient's privacy and comfort is accommodated. Maintains patients dignity throughout the exam/procedure.
  • Demonstrates competence in the determination and application of appropriate procedures, equipment, supplies and techniques based on the age of patients.
  • Organizes schedule, time and priorities so that required activities are accomplished within designated time frames.
  • Follows physicians instructions when assisting with procedures and exams.
  • Uses critical thinking skills.
  • Dialogs with patient/family.
  • Asks clarifying questions.
  • Seeks clarification on ambiguous orders.
  • Understands, demonstrates and documents preprocedural verification and Time Out process when appropriate.
  • Demonstrates and understands pre-and-post procedural care.
  • Preps the patient for the procedure.
  • Demonstrates and understands sterile technique.
  • Maintains competency with venipuncture.

Education and Communications

  • Patiently and clearly explains purpose and nature of exam to patient prior to starting of procedure, to minimize anxiety and facilitate cooperation using AIDET; Acknowledge, Introduce, Discuss, Explain, and Thank you of all patients and family members.
  • Ensures that patient's questions, concerns or contraindications are satisfactorily addressed, notifying physician when this cannot be accomplished, prior to the initiation of the procedure.
  • Participates in the orientation and training of departmental employees.
  • Required documentation is concise, legible and includes precise terminology.
  • Reads email each day scheduled to work and follows through with assignment.
  • Completes mandatory departmental and Hospital-wide education without prompting.

Quality Control

  • Consistently produces acceptable images, as evidenced by radiologist feedback and quality audits.
  • Ensures that equipment is fully operational prior to each use, by checking for proper calibration and operating deficiencies.
  • Sends all studies to PACS immediately after completion, prints CDs as needed.
  • Studies that have been transmitted after hours to teleradiography are printed and scanned in PACS, if applicable.
  • Completes all studies in RIS before completing in PACS.
  • Prints completed log sheet from teleradiography and submits to Radiologist, if applicable.

Operations

  • Restocks linens and supplies, and maintains NM department in clean and orderly condition.
  • Transports patients, positions patients, and helps them on and off procedure table.
  • Performs patient charging activities on the day the service is rendered.
  • Applies supportive and immobilization devices and equipment.
  • Willingly lends knowledge and assistance to others upon request as needed and routinely as time is available, without prompting, so that all working time is used for departmental advantage.
  • Performs routine duties of clerical and support personnel in accordance with procedure when warranted to ensure continuity and quality of services.
  • Keeps supervisor informed on all responsibilities on an ongoing basis, ensuring prompt notification in the event of problems or potential problems.
  • Maintains an individual productivity rate equal to other co-workers.
  • Ability to operate NM equipment within the department.
  • Maintains Joint Commission standards and any other regulatory agency standards.
  • Any other duties as assigned.
  • Takes call when necessary.

title: Pricing Architect
description:
About the Role

We're an early-stage AI-powered pricing optimization SaaS startup helping B2B companies turn pricing from a static exercise into a continuously improving, data-driven system. Our platform spans the full pricing lifecycle — from packaging and price architecture to deal execution and sales coaching — and we're growing fast.

We're looking for a Pricing Architect based in Amsterdam to own high-impact pricing engagements with our customers end-to-end. This is a senior, client-facing role at the intersection of commercial strategy, AI, and SaaS monetization. You'll work directly with C-suite stakeholders and cross-functional teams to design and deliver pricing strategies that drive real revenue outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Lead customer pricing engagements independently — from initial discovery through to a live pricing and proposition model.

  • Design segmentation frameworks, packaging structures, price metrics, and monetization logic tailored to each customer's business context.

  • Apply advanced pricing methods including willingness-to-pay analysis, price elasticity modeling, discount architecture, and usage-based or consumption pricing.

title: Team Lead - Data Platform
description:
About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our videoto explore what makes us unique

Why Data & Analytics at AMBOSS?

Join a high-trust, cross-functional team where data sits at the heart of every product decision, commercial bet and operational process. You will work side-by-side with our Analytics team, Product, Engineering, Commercial, Medical and Operations colleagues to turn a modern, cloud-native stack (GCP/AWS, BigQuery, Airflow, Airbyte, dbt, Looker, Mixpanel, Claude Code) plus a growing set of integrations and internal tools into reliable insights that move the business forward. Your work will guide decisions that reach medical students and clinicians worldwide, directly advancing our mission to enable all medical professionals to provide the best possible care.

Role Overview

As Data Platform Lead you will be the people manager of a small, senior team and the domain expert steering AMBOSS's end-to-end data platform strategy. That said, the role is broader than a classic data platform mandate. Beyond owning platform evolution and pipelines, you and your team also own the integration layer to our ERP and other core business systems. On top of that you build small services and internal tools that solve specific business and operations problems. One current example is our master data management service for medical institutions around the world, which powers B2B commercial work and product experience.

This role is more dynamic and more business-forward than a pure engineering leadership position. Communication with stakeholders across Commercial, Product, Finance, Operations and Medical is constant. Engineering excellence still matters, but coordination, prioritization, fast judgement calls and a strong hands-on mentality matter at least as much.

You will:

  • Set the course. Own and sequence the roadmap across the data platform, ERP and business systems integrations, plus the internal tools and services your team builds and runs.

  • Own the Single Source of Truth for the entire company so Analysts, Scientists and stakeholders across departments speak the same data language and use the same metrics.

  • Develop the team. Hire, mentor and grow 3 to 5 Data Engineers. Run clear goal-setting and feedback cycles.

  • Architect for scale. Design and review core components: batch and real-time pipelines, modeling layers, integrations, governance, observability and CI/CD so Analysts, Data Scientists and other Engineering teams can self-serve with confidence.

  • Build internal services and tools to unblock the business. Our master data management service for medical institutions is one example. Expect more of these as the business grows.

  • Partner with Commercial, Finance, Product, Operations and Medical. Translate ambiguous business needs into systems and data products that move the company forward.

  • Navigate ambiguity and stay hands-on. Create structure where there is none, sequence the work pragmatically and make the call when there is no obvious right answer. This is not a step-back-and-review-PRs role. You will be in the work alongside your team on the highest-leverage problems.

  • Raise the bar. Codify engineering standards for code quality, testing, reliability and incident response. Scale agentic coding and AI-assisted workflows so a small team can punch above its weight.

  • Stay tool-agnostic: evaluate, pilot and when needed retire technologies based on evidence rather than hype.

You Bring:

  • 5+ years in data engineering or data platform roles, including 2+ years leading projects or people.

  • Deep SQL and strong Python. Production experience with Airflow, dbt or comparable frameworks.

  • Hands-on expertise with cloud warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) and at least one major cloud provider (AWS or GCP).

  • Proven CI/CD and IaC chops (GitHub Actions, Terraform or similar).

  • Solid grasp of data modelling, governance and observability patterns.

  • Experience integrating with or building against business systems such as ERP, Shop or even Bank integrations. You are comfortable owning that layer end to end.

  • A track record of working closely with Commercial, Finance, Operations or Analytics stakeholders and treating them as first-class partners.

  • A bias to action in ambiguous situations. You would rather make a reasonable call and adjust than wait for perfect information.

  • Hands-on fluency with agentic coding AI tools (like Claude Code) and a track record of using AI to accelerate engineering work.

  • Excellent English communication. German is a plus.

  • Bonus: exposure to AI/LLM workloads or vector databases on the production side.

You enjoy:

  • Operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the plane gets built while you are flying in it. You like being pragmatic and bringing in structure without slowing the business down.

  • Coordinating across many stakeholders. You move easily between an engineering deep-dive in the morning and a Commercial leadership conversation in the afternoon.

  • Staying hands-on as a leader. You are happy to write SQL, debug an integration or scope an internal tool yourself when that is what the situation calls for.

  • Translating between worlds. You take messy business problems and turn them into clear technical scope. You take technical trade-offs and turn them into concise narratives executives can act on.

  • Coaching and unblocking engineers and analysts through clear expectations and constructive feedback.

  • Seeing the platform-level picture: designing for security, self-service and future scale rather than one-off pipelines.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
Mercura (YC W25) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and grew to $2M ARR in our first year. With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US.

About the role

This is a technical role at the center of how we win enterprise deals. Our customers are technical suppliers: industrial, careful with their buying decisions, and often disappointed by software before. They don't decide based on a pitch. They decide when they see Mercura take one of their own messy quote requests and return a correct quote, on their data.

That is hard to do well. Real requests are unstructured, product catalogs are complex, and quotes run through ERP systems that every customer configures differently. A standard demo rarely survives the first real edge case.

So most enterprise deals come down to one question: can someone make Mercura work, credibly, inside this specific customer's setup? If this sounds exciting, this role is for you.

Your responsibilities

You own the technical side of every major deal, from the first demo to a signed customer.

  • Understand the customer's reality. Get into the customer’s actual workflows and identify the case that best shows what Mercura can do for them.

  • Lead the technical conversation. Join sales conversations and be the credible counterpart on integrations, data, security, and architecture. Resolve the concerns that stand between the customer and a buying decision.

  • Build the proof. Set up demos and proof-of-concepts on the customer's real data that you prepared and structured. Build prototypes for new features, and make customers feel that Mercura works in their own context rather than an idealized one.

  • Feed insights back to the team. You're often the first to see why a deal stalls. Judge whether a customer request is demo-only, a quick customer-specific build, or something that needs core product and engineering - and translate that into clear, prioritized input for the team.


Who we're looking for

  • Native-level communication in German: You can explain clearly, present well to senior stakeholders, and stay composed when a demo is tested in real time.

  • You’ve worked for 2+ years in a Solution Engineering, technical customer success, technical consulting or similar.

  • You have technical understanding. You can reason about our customers' systems, integrations, and build a convincing, working proof yourself. You can write code in JavaScript and Python, are comfortable with APIs, and have a feel for integration architectures.

  • You hear the real problem behind a customer’s request. You translate complex concepts for non-technical stakeholders, turn customer needs into buildable specs, and make abstract products feel tangible through demos that close deals.

  • Commercial judgment. You read a room, identify the real blocker, how to speak a customer's language, and move deals forward.

  • You want to work in an in-person, high-intensity environment in Munich

Note: Studies show that men often apply when they meet only part of the criteria, while women and marginalized groups tend to wait until they meet every requirement. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it, we'd love to hear from you.

Why join Mercura

  • A foundational role. As our first Solution Engineer, you build the demo environment, the proof-of-concept approach, and the technical-sales motion, rather than inheriting them.

  • Direct influence on the product. You sit one step from product and engineering, and what you learn in deals shapes what we build next.

  • A large, underserved market. We automate the manual ERP work in a $12T+ industry that still runs on emails, PDFs, phone calls, and manual processes. The need is real, and the market is largely untouched by modern software.

  • Real ownership and upside. You receive real shares in the company with voting rights, not just VSOP/ESOP.

  • A strong team. Operators, ex-founders, and experienced engineers who set a high bar and support each other.

  • A high-growth, high-commitment environment: We’re growing extremely fast because we always put our work and our customers first. If you excel in fast-paced settings and want to grow as part of something big from day one, Mercura is for you.

  • Build something with real-world impact: We ship code that directly helps a massive, yet overlooked manual industry run more efficiently and sustainably.

  • Build a category-defining company: Mercura has the potential to reach significance. As an early team member, you will have a direct, lasting impact on our culture, processes, technology, and product.

Your team

  • Lukas — Co-Founder & CEO; ex-Google, research in Cambridge; his family has been in construction for over 100 years.

  • Lars (prev. Sales at Tacto, Consulting at OMMAX, FTE #2 at Econos)

  • Kolya (prev. SWE at SF-based startup Etleap)

  • Nico (prev. Engineering at SaaS startups Luminovo & Fides)

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity (Real shares in our company with the most favorable tax treatment - no VSOP/ESOP)

  • Fast career advancement opportunities in a rapidly growing team

  • An ambitious and caring team that sees their work as more than just a job

  • Free team dinner (up to 4x/week)

  • UrbanSportsClub membership and access to a company bike - join our team workouts 3x/week

  • Relocation support if you're moving to Munich from elsewhere

  • Access to any AI or productivity tools you want


Interview process

  1. Intro call with the Chief of Staff Annabell Vacano.

  2. Take-Home challenge

  3. Technical interview with our Founding FDE Engineer Nico Stabla

  4. On-site with the whole team in our Munich office.

  5. Offer & reference checks — a strong fit receives an offer. We'll also ask for 2–3 references.

About the Founders

We are Lukas, Stefan & Sean, the co-founders of Mercura.

We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible.

Two of us come from non-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility.

Lukas (left) is responsible for business development at Mercura. With his background as a Data Scientist at Allianz and at Google in Silicon Valley, he brings extensive expertise in data and AI.
Lukas’ family has been active in the construction industry for over 100 years, giving him a deep understanding and passion for the sector's specific needs.

Sean (middle) is responsible for technical development at Mercura. As a top 0.01% physicist, Sean earned a Silver medal for Germany at the International Physics Olympiad (IPhO), began researching with the Max Planck Institute at the age of 16, and has since published at leading machine learning conferences.

Stefan (right) leads product development at Mercura. Previously, he worked in management consulting at Bain & Company, where he helped manufacturers improve their operations.
Stefan leverages his research experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard Business School to develop innovative solutions for the industry.

At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins.

Beyond Mercura, we actively support initiatives that promote diversity and gender equity and commit a portion of our personal income each year to organizations expanding opportunity for others.

Our company values

title: Senior Technical Project Manager (all genders)
description:
Senior Technical Project Manager (all genders)

Thorit GmbH · Böblingen, Germany · Hybrid · Full-time · Available immediately

About the Role

You will own delivery for our software projects end to end: HubSpot CMS builds, custom development, system integrations, and AI agent engineering for enterprise B2B clients. You sit inside the Engineering team, not next to it, which means you baseline the project, defend the estimate, run the delivery rhythm, and stay the single accountable person from kickoff to handover. If you are technical enough to argue with an engineer and commercial enough to negotiate scope with a client, this is that seat.

What You'll Do

  • Own scope, budget, and timeline for a portfolio of software and agent engineering projects, from baseline to go-live.

  • Baseline every project properly: person-day estimates, milestones, dependencies, and a live risk log in Jira, Confluence, and Forecast.

  • Run one clear weekly delivery rhythm across the Engineering team: sprint reviews, risk reviews, change control, and a status pack clients actually read.

  • Protect the margin by catching scope drift early and turning it into signed Change Requests instead of unbilled work.

  • Challenge estimates. You will push back on both optimistic and padded numbers, and build an estimation model the team can reuse.

  • Lead distributed engineering squads across Böblingen and Lisbon without formal authority over them.

  • Automate your own reporting with AI tooling, so status packs take minutes rather than half a day.

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years running software delivery projects (web platforms, custom development, or integrations) in an agency, consultancy, or product organisation.

  • Demonstrable ownership of budget and scope, not just timeline coordination. You can talk through a project's numbers, not only its Gantt chart.

  • Enough technical depth to read an API contract, a data model, or a pull request and hold your own with senior engineers.

  • Experience negotiating scope changes with client stakeholders and converting them into commercial agreements.

  • German at business level (client steering committees run in German) plus fluent English (engineering work runs in English).

  • Comfort in a distributed setup with colleagues in two countries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on exposure to HubSpot CMS, HubSpot APIs, or a comparable platform ecosystem.

  • Experience with AI-assisted delivery work, agent workflows, or LLM tooling in a delivery context.

  • A background that started technical (development, QA, solution engineering) before moving into delivery management.

Your Team

You will report to the Practice Lead Development & Technology and join the Development Team inside Thorit's Development & Technology Practice, alongside software engineers, AI engineers, technical consultants, and UX designers across Böblingen and Lisbon. The Team Lead Development seat is currently open, so you will work directly with the Practice Lead and have unusual room to shape how software delivery runs here. You will also work closely with the PMO Practice, which owns delivery method across the company.

Tech Stack

HubSpot (CMS, custom modules, APIs), Jira, Confluence, Forecast, Claude and Claude Code, GitHub and GitHub Actions, MCP-based agent tooling, Miro, Figma for design handover.

What We Offer

  • 30 vacation days per year, plus Baden-Württemberg public holidays on top.

  • Hybrid working from our Böblingen HQ, in a team that is genuinely used to distributed collaboration.

  • Company pension plan with an employer contribution that grows with tenure, starting at 50 EUR per month.

  • Business Bike leasing with the 0.25 percent tax advantage, full insurance, annual service, and free brand choice.

  • Lunch subsidy of 5 EUR tax-free per working day, up to 100 EUR per month, usable in restaurants, supermarkets, and delivery apps.

  • Corporate Benefits discount platform covering travel, tech, fashion, mobility, and insurance, free to use.

  • E-scooters at the office for local trips during the working day.

  • Real AI exposure. You will not read about agentic delivery in a strategy deck, you will run the projects that build it and use AI tooling in your own daily work.

About Thorit

Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. Agentic means software that acts on goals instead of waiting for clicks. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner we work with enterprise B2B clients across the DACH market, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it with them.

Ready to Apply?

Send your application via Ashby. A cover letter is optional, but a concrete example of a software project where you personally owned the budget, including what the final numbers looked like against your baseline, is required.

VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement & Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit .

Our Commerce & Technology division helps leading global brands deliver digital experiences. As clients transition from AI experimentation to production-grade, autonomous agentic platforms (systems that plan, reason, act, and transact), we are seeking a Principal Technical Architect. Serving as the senior technical authority on our AWS and cloud engagements, you will own the design and quality of robust, scalable applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect Agentic Solutions: Design enterprise cloud applications, specializing in agentic AI platform components (orchestration, memory, tool integration, identity, guardrails, observability) and emerging Agentic Commerce.
  • Lead Clients & Drive Growth: Serve as an outward-facing, energetic leader who runs workshops, participates in governance, and collaborates with commercial teams to identify and shape technical growth opportunities.
  • Hands-on Delivery & Mentorship: Remain close to the detail by proving solutions, reviewing code, and mentoring engineering teams to set a high bar for quality, automation, and best practices.

What you’ll be doing

  • Technical Leadership & Governance: Act as the account's senior authority on complex cloud architectures (esp. AWS serverless). Establish technical governance, design standards, and manage risk, non-functional requirements (NFRs), and technical debt.
  • Agentic AI & Commerce Innovation: Design AWS-based agentic AI platforms (orchestration, RAG, memory, guardrails, and MCP). Establish reusable patterns and advise clients on emerging Agentic Commerce standards (ACP, AP2, A2A, and secure payment models).
  • Client Engagement & Account Growth: Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, translate complex concepts, and facilitate technical discovery workshops. Proactively identify, shape, and pitch technical solutions to drive account growth.
  • Hands-on Engineering & Delivery: Provide hands-on technical ownership by proving solutions, reviewing code, and designing robust API/integration patterns. Champion a quality-first mindset using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), CI/CD, and automation.
  • Capability Building: Mentor engineers and architects, share knowledge on emerging technologies, and raise the overall technical bar across the account and practice.

What we want from you

  • Leadership & Consulting: Senior/Principal architect with experience in digital agencies or consultancies, skilled at leading development teams, guiding clients through workshops, and identifying business growth opportunities.
  • AWS & Serverless Architecture: Deep hands-on expertise in designing, documenting, and delivering resilient, high-availability enterprise applications on AWS (including serverless patterns and appropriate integration components).
  • Agentic AI & Commerce: Strong understanding of building agentic AI platforms on AWS (e.g., Bedrock, orchestrations, RAG, gateways/MCP) and awareness of emerging Agentic Commerce concepts and standards (ACP, AP2, A2A).
  • Software Engineering & API Design: Strong development background (ideally TypeScript/JavaScript) coupled with robust API design, documentation, and versioning experience.
  • DevOps & Quality Automation: Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/CDK/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and a strict quality-first mindset (unit testing, automated tooling).
  • Communication & Collaboration: Proactive, energetic collaborator with excellent written, verbal, and diagrammatic skills capable of translating complex technical concepts for senior stakeholders.

If you know some of this, even better

  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional (or Associate as a minimum)
  • AWS Specialty certifications (e.g., Security, Data/ML)
  • Familiarity with:
  • The C4 model
  • Diagrams-as-code
  • DevOps practices
  • Headless architectures
  • Practical application of LLMs within enterprises

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Permanent only:
We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

How we use AI in the recruitment process:

To ensure more focused and engaging conversations, we leverage AI in our recruitment process exclusively for secure, objective note-taking, never for evaluative judgments. This allows our team to be fully present with you. You are always welcome to request a transcript of these notes or opt out of this feature at any time. Opting out will not impact the outcome of the interview process"

title: Software Engineer (Generative AI and Innovation)
description:
Company:

Marsh

Description:

Excited by the pace of AI and the chance to build something meaningful? Join our growing Innovation team in Dublin and help create next-generation applications using the latest tools, technologies, and ideas. AI is a huge part of what we do — but we’re an innovation team first, applying whatever emerging technology best solves the problem, from LLMs to data, integration, and automation.

You’ll work alongside experienced and curious colleagues in a collaborative environment that encourages exploration, learning, and shared problem-solving. With strong support from senior leaders and visibility across the business, the team is well placed to develop, test, and scale new solutions. Your work will be visible, valued, and connected to key priorities from day one.

This is a hybrid position with a requirement of 3 days in the office.

THE ROLE & YOUR MISSION

This is an opportunity to grow as an engineer while building, testing, and scaling solutions that make a real difference. As a mid-level member of the team, you’ll take ownership of features and components end to end, turning ideas into practical applications that address real business and client needs — with AI and LLMs the biggest part of the toolkit, alongside data, integration, and automation. Alongside hands-on engineering, you’ll help shape our innovation hub by contributing to hackathons, engaging with the broader tech community, and supporting a culture centered on experimentation, learning, collaboration, and results.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own medium-scale features and components end to end, from prototyping through to production-ready solutions, with senior guidance available when you need it

  • Contribute to design discussions, bringing sound technical reasoning and viable suggestions to the table

  • Build practical applications — AI-powered and otherwise — that address real business problems and deliver measurable value

  • Work closely with colleagues across our Dublin and international Innovation teams, while taking initiative and contributing your own ideas

  • Work in an Agile environment where you can experiment, learn quickly, and see the impact of your work

  • Stay hands-on with the latest AI tools, models, and techniques, with ongoing opportunities to learn, test, and evolve

  • Build and maintain evaluation harnesses and follow good practice in prompt engineering, experimentation, and solution design

  • Create reusable components, tools, and patterns that help the wider team work more effectively and consistently

  • Share what you learn, support technical quality, and help junior colleagues grow through code reviews and pairing

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

This is a chance to accelerate your career in a team that’s growing quickly and working with purpose. You’ll own meaningful work, explore the latest technologies, and develop your craft while helping shape how we build. With strong leadership support, visibility across the business, and access to the resources of a global organization, you’ll have the platform to make a genuine impact while continuing to grow. And you’ll do it from Dublin, one of Europe’s most dynamic and well-connected tech hubs.

What you need to have:

  • Solid software engineering experience (typically 2–5 years), with a track record of delivering features independently

  • Experience contributing to production-grade applications

  • Hands-on experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript development, including a framework such as React, Vue, or Angular

  • Backend experience with Node.js, NestJS, or similar technologies

  • Experience using Python to build AI-powered workflows, integrations, or applications

  • Good understanding of APIs and integrating AI into real-world products and business processes

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including prompt design, tool use, and structured outputs

  • Familiarity with RAG, retrieval pipelines, and embeddings

  • Exposure to modern agent patterns and multi-step, tool-connected workflows

  • Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes, and an interest in how AI applications are deployed and scaled

  • Good communication skills, a practical and thoughtful approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work across engineering and business teams

What makes you stand out:

  • Experience taking features from early experimentation through to production use

  • Curiosity about emerging standards in the agent ecosystem, including Model Context Protocol (MCP)

  • Exposure to vector databases and semantic search

  • An eye for the quality, reliability, latency, and cost-efficiency of AI systems

  • Exposure to AI evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, and guardrails for reliable and responsible AI

  • A willingness to support others and contribute to engineering best practices

We know that candidates may not meet every listed requirement exactly. If you’re excited about the role and believe you could thrive in it, we encourage you to apply.

Why join our team:

  • We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
  • We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
  • Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

#MMCIC

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit corporate.marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Massage therapy
description:
A massage therapist manipulates soft tissues and joints to relieve pain, reduce stress, and improve overall well-being, using various techniques and tools like hands, fingers, and forearms.

Here's a more detailed look at the role:

  • Core Responsibilities:Client Assessment: Evaluate clients' needs, medical history, and treatment goals.
    Massage Techniques: Perform various massage techniques (e.g., Swedish, deep tissue, sports massage) to address specific needs.
    Pain Relief: Relieve muscle tension, pain, and stress through massage therapy.
    Mobility and Circulation: Improve mobility and circulation through manipulation of soft tissues.
    Client Education: Provide guidance on stretching, strengthening, and relaxation techniques.
    Record Keeping: Document client conditions and progress.
    Workspace Management: Maintain a clean and sanitized workspace and equipment.
    Collaboration: Collaborate with other healthcare professionals (e.g., chiropractors, physicians).
  • Tools and Techniques:Hands-on Approach: Use hands, fingers, forearms, elbows, and feet to manipulate tissues.
    Massage Modalities: Employ various massage modalities, including Swedish, deep tissue, sports massage, and hot stone therapy.
    Aromatherapy: Use aromatherapy to enhance relaxation and well-being.
    Tools: May use massage tables, chairs, lotions, and oils.
  • Working Environment:Diverse Settings: Work in various settings, including spas, wellness centers, hospitals, and private practices.
    Self-Employment: Some massage therapists work as independent practitioners.
    Client Interaction: Communicate effectively with clients to understand their needs and provide personalized care.
  • Skills and Qualities:Anatomy and Physiology Knowledge: Possess a strong understanding of the human body's anatomy and physiology.
    Technical Skills: Master various massage techniques and modalities.
    Communication Skills: Communicate effectively with clients and other healthcare professionals.
    Empathy and Compassion: Show empathy and compassion for clients' needs.Physical Stamina: Possess the physical stamina to perform massage therapy for extended periods.

title: Compliance Specialist - Investments
description:
Company:

Mercer

Description:

What can you expect:

Mercer Investments is Mercer’s investment management arm which manages in excess of US$650bn globally. The European Investment management business (Mercer Global Investments Europe Limited or “MGIE”) was established in 2006 and currently manages assets in excess of $180bn. Investment is via Mercer’s Irish domiciled fund range (the “Mercer Funds”) managed by Mercer Global Investment Management Limited, a UCITS Management Company and AIFM, which consists of 100+ Irish domiciled sub funds across five umbrella structures, as well as external funds and segregated mandates.

The business has experienced significant growth over the last 10 years and with a strong pipeline of activity, this looks set to continue for the foreseeable future. This growth has involved new client on-boarding, as well as more recent inorganic growth across the broader Mercer Investments group, and has seen the business further enhance its product and service offering and its position in the market.

Mercer’s Compliance Department protects Mercer’s reputation and provides advice to the Company. It understands, challenges and advises on the impact of regulation in our business, with the objective of:

  • Actively participating in business decisions to champion our clients’ interests
  • Collaborating with the business to position Compliance centrally in their daily work;
  • Ensuring securing client interests is at the centre of everything we do;
  • Cultivating and enhancing the compliance culture within Mercer;

A Compliance Specialist role has become available on the MGIE Compliance Team. This role will fall under the Central Bank of Ireland (“CBI”) Fitness and Probity Regime, and the successful candidate (subject to the completion of due diligence) will hold a CF2 role - Ensuring, controlling or monitoring compliance by a regulated financial service provider with its relevant obligations. As a CF2 role holder, you will also be subject to the Common Conduct Standards under the Individual Accountability Framework.

The roleholder will report to a Senior Compliance Manager who reports to the MGIE Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) and be responsible for assisting in the oversight and management of regulatory and other risks in respect of Mercer’s Investments business in Ireland and other jurisdictions relevant to that business, including its branches in Germany and Sweden.

We will rely on you for:

  • Monitor investment restriction and guideline breaches arising in respect of the Mercer Funds in Ireland, including sustainability related commitments across the platform.
  • Perform reviews and consider potential investment vehicles against the relevant regulations and fund documentation in relation to the Mercer Funds and other portfolios.
  • Liaise with the fund manager in relation to investment issues on the Mercer product range.
  • Support regular liaison with the depositary of the Mercer Funds, maintenance of logs and review of regulatory reports.
  • Monitor quarterly investment management questionnaires and oversight of due diligence of investment managers.
  • Assistance in the review of fund documentation ahead of launch and on an ongoing basis.
  • Roll out, tracking and review of quarterly employee declarations and oversight of the personal trading monitoring system.
  • Develop and maintain policies and procedures supporting a culture of integrity, risk management and excellence in the Investments business in Ireland.
  • Assist with the identification of potential risks and financial services compliance issues associated with new products, services and jurisdictions in the Investments business.
  • Review and approve marketing materials/RFPs for the Mercer Funds and regulated investment activities.
  • Prepare various reports for senior members of the Investment business (as needed).
  • Support the governance process relating to the Investments business and the entities that host this (most notably the Risk Committees and the Board).
  • Conduct periodic compliance monitoring assessments of the business and where necessary, any third party providers.
  • Developing and conducting periodic training for Investments personnel relating to regulated activities.
  • Assisting with the management of regulatory matters and compliance issues, including correspondence with regulators, overseeing regulatory examinations; implementation of new regulations etc

What you will need to have:

  • Highly motivated with a passion for compliance in the asset management/investment funds industry.
  • A broad understanding of legal and regulatory requirements related to the operation of MGIE. This includes Irish (and EU) Investments regulation in particular MiFID and UCITS & AIFMD related to the Mercer Funds for which MGIE acts as Investment Manager..
  • Good knowledge of fund structures, different fund types and different assets class would be an advantage.
  • Minimum of three year’s investment compliance experience.
  • Takes initiative and ownership of responsibilities assigned.
  • Ability to prioritize activities while working on multiple tasks and achieve target deadlines.
  • Ability to work effectively within a small, fast growing team and assist in the development of that team.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to communicate with internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
  • Fluent English essential.

What makes you stand out:

  • Fund Compliance experience particularly advantageous.
  • A current role in the Risk, Audit or Compliance group of an asset management/regulatory advisory firm would be valued.

Why join our team:

  • We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
  • We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can collaborate with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
  • Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities.

title: Jr Software Developer
description:
Description

Leidos is seeking a Jr level Software Developer, who will be a member of a dynamic team in Gaithersburg, MD, working on the development/maintenance of software that improves aircraft runway and terminal congestion.

Nationwide congestion is increasing, and the need for efficient aircraft traffic planning is critical. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Terminal Flight Data Manager (TFDM) is the surface management solution that will provide NextGen Air Traffic Control capabilities to improve air traffic operations in the National Airspace System (NAS). The Terminal Flight Data Management (TFDM) program is a Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) NextGen program based on airport surface management that provides efficiency for both the airport surface and terminal airspace by providing a new and comprehensive integrated surface traffic control and management system. We are a team of forward-looking professionals in need of a strong candidate with these key required skills: Modern Development (PHP, Python, Java), Structured Data (XML, XSD, XSLT, JSON, CSV), Agile / Scrum development, Drupal, relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle).


TFDM functions include Surface Collaborative Decision making (SCDM), departure scheduler and other airport decision tools Electronic Flight Data (EFD);
Enhanced Air Traffic Control Tower (ATCT) Traffic Flow Management System (TFMS) Replacement or integration of multiple systems in the National Airspace System (NAS). TFDM will share data among controllers, aircraft operators, and airports so they can better stage arrivals and departures and manage traffic flow within terminal airspace for greater efficiency. Stakeholders will have a shared awareness of flights on the ground and in the air, the ability to exchange data electronically, with the goal of a continuous real-time picture of traffic volume and airport resources, making flights more efficient from gate to gate.

Responsibilities:

  • Architect, design, develop, and implement next-generation application using software engineering best practices in the latest technologies:
    • Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible)
    • Content Management System (Drupal, WordPress)
    • DevOps and CI/CD tooling (Bamboo, Docker, SonarQube, Ansible)
  • Provide software expertise in one or more of these areas: application integration, RESTful services, Drupal administration, security, workflow automation, module integration, user experience (UX), and accessibility compliance (Section 508/WCAG/USDS standards).
  • Investigate and repair application defects regardless of component: automation, front-end, business logic, middleware, or database (PL/SQL and Data Modeling).
  • Brief management, customer, team, or vendors using written or oral skills at appropriate technical level for audience
  • All other duties as assigned or directed

FOUNDATION FOR SUCCESS (Basic Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, mathematics, engineering, or related technical discipline. Master’s or Doctorate degree may substitute for required experience.
  • 3+ years of combined experience with modern software development (PHP, Python, Java)
  • 1+ years of combined experience with web development and building responsive UIs with modern front-end technologies
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

FACTORS TO HELP YOU SHINE (Required Skills)

These skills will help you succeed in this position:

  • Solid understanding of modern PHP frameworks (Drupal, Laravel, Symfony).
  • Experience developing modern PHP applications using object-oriented programming principles and contemporary PHP language features including typed properties and union types.
  • Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining software applications used to create, validate, transform, and manage structured data formats including JSON, CSV, XML, XSD, and XSLT.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of XML schema design (XSD), XSLT transformations, and structured data validation techniques.
  • Experience with automated testing methodologies including unit, integration, and behavior-driven testing using tools such as PHPUnit, Behat/Cucumber, Selenium, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Solid knowledge of front-end technologies including HTML5, JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS3, and responsive UI development principles.
  • Strong experience in automating tasks with scripting languages like Bash, Shell, or Python
  • Experience in use of the UNIX and Linux operating systems
  • Experience using DevOps and CI/CD tools including Git/Bitbucket, Bamboo/Jenkins, SonarQube, and automated build/deployment pipelines.

HOW TO STAND OUT FROM THE CROWD (Desired Skills)

Showcase your knowledge of modern development through the following experience or skills:

  • Strong experience with Ansible Automation and authoring playbooks and roles for installing, maintaining, or upgrading platforms
  • Experience building, packaging, and deploying software applications in Linux environments using RPM-based distribution mechanisms.
  • Experience deploying or supporting applications in AWS cloud environments, related certifications.
  • Experience with AI assisted software development.
  • Experience using Atlassian collaboration and development tools including Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and Bamboo.
  • Experience with relational databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Oracle including SQL optimization and ORM technologies such as Doctrine or Eloquent.
  • Experience with FAA and air traffic domain knowledge.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites

Etsimme nyt kivijalkakahvilaamme, joka sijaitsee Pyhän kompaktissa keskustassa, ravintola-alan monitaituria ottamaan roolia kahvilamme päivittäisestä itsenäisestä hoitamisesta, sekä olemaan omalla panoksella mukana toiminnan kehittämisessä.

Toivomme persoonasi tuovan meille omannäköistä hymyäsi ja asennetta. Siitä tiimimme tunnetaan ja olemme saaneet kiitosta. Emme laita sinua tiettyyn muottiin, vaan saat loistaa omana itsenäsi. Päivittäistä asiakastyötä helpottaa kuitenkin englannin kielitaito, aikaisempi kokemus ravintola-alalta tai ruuan parissa toimimisesta sekä se legendaarinen tilannetaju.

Jos taskussasi on anniskelu- ja hygieniapassi, se nopeuttaa töiden aloittamista.

Olemme kasvava ja innovatiivinen yritys, ja tarjoamme siistin sisätyön sekä inhimillisten työaikojen ohella alan normeja paremmat ansiot sekä rahanarvoiset henkilöstöedut. Autamme tarvittaessa myös majoituksen hankinnassa.

Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä. Kerromme mielellämme lisää laadukkaasta elämästä Pyhällä - ja toki myös työstä sekä kehittymismahdollisuuksista!
