When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Head of Security Platforms

Why We Have This Role

Qualtrics operates in a world where security threats are evolving and being as secure as possible is paramount. The Engineering Security Manager is essential to Qualtrics' operations, tasked with protecting our products and infrastructure from increasing security risks. This person will maintain company-wide security standards, leading a skilled team of security engineers and collaborating across product units to address security challenges. The impact of their role is broad - they will help protect customer data, uphold the company's reputation, and ensure ongoing secure service delivery.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Proactive Leadership: Take the initiative, understanding the expected outcome, getting the necessary context, and working entrepreneurially to achieve the set goals in security engineering.
  • Stellar Communication: Communicate effectively at all levels and influence appropriately to create trust within the team and across the business to induce high standards and change practices.
  • Security Expertise: Broad expertise in platform security, demonstrating an in-depth understanding of different security facets, including product, cloud, and infrastructure security.
  • Collaboration Skills: Working across various product units, they will display excellent collaboration skills, building strong relationships to drive security initiatives forward.
  • Decision-Making and Problem Solving: Possess strong decision-making skills, able to tackle complex security issues swiftly and effectively in an autonomous date driven capacity.
  • Continuous Learning: Committed to continuous learning, staying abreast of the latest security trends, threats, and mitigation strategies.

How You’ll Grow

  • Industry Exposure: As the head of security engineering, the person will be regularly interacting with industry leaders and participating in top security forums, widening their network and gaining industry insights.
  • Knowledge Expansion: By staying current with the latest trends in security, they'd also continually augment their knowledge and understandings of both emergent threats and innovative mitigation strategies.
  • Leadership Development: Leading a team of dedicated security engineers, they will have ample opportunities to refine their leadership and people management skills in a global company.
  • Strategic Influence: They will have the chance to influence the company's security strategy, translating their insights and views into actions that make a real difference. This strategic contribution can enhance their decision-making and problem-solving skills.

Things You’ll Do

  • Enhance Platform Security: Build and implement comprehensive security solutions across product, multicloud, and infrastructure areas to reduce vulnerabilities and potential breaches.
  • Drive Vulnerability Management: Establish an effective vulnerability management system, conducting regular checks and swiftly acting upon detected issues.
  • Develop Data Protection Protocols: Define and enforce strict data protection protocols for adherence throughout the organization, ensuring customer data security.
  • Access Management: Oversee aspects of access across the corporate and production environments setting the standards and best practices.
  • Team Leadership: Lead a team of skilled security engineers and foster a security-conscious culture, promoting continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate Across Business & Product Units: Work closely with all areas of the business, forging partnerships to support security initiatives and create a coherent front against emerging risks.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

While we value the wealth of experience, we put more emphasis on your capability and the outcomes you've produced. For this role, these elements are particularly important:

  • Proven Leadership: We're looking for evidence of effective team leadership for over 15 years, particularly in the field of security. Details of how you've influenced cultural shifts towards improved security practices will be a plus.
  • Expertise in Diverse Security Aspects: We want to see your proficiency in dealing with multiple security aspects ideally in product, cloud, and infrastructure security, including vulnerability management, access management, CDN/WaF/firewalls, product security, and data protection.

  • Proactive Problem-Solving: Share instances where you acted swiftly and effectively to manage potential vulnerabilities or address complex security issues.
  • Strategy Development: Ideally, you've defined and implemented security strategies in previous roles, driving transformative outcomes.

Remember, it's not about how many years you've worked; it's about what you've achieved during that time that counts.

description:

You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities May Include:

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives on shift, implementing best practices to enhance efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness across end to end operations.

  • Address performance and attendance matters in collaboration with HR, ensuring that all plant staff meet operational expectations.
  • Ensure full compliance with CHEP procedures and work instructions, ensuring tasks are completed accurately and in line with company standards and operational goals.

Shift Production Manager
Location: CHEP Park Road, Pontefract, WF8 4QD
Shift Pattern: Monday to Friday Double Days (6am-2pm/2pm-10pm)
Type: Full Time, Permanent

Are you a people-focused manufacturing leader who thrives on developing teams, improving performance, and making decisions based on data rather than instinct? Do you enjoy leading through others, coaching frontline leaders, and using operational insights to drive measurable results?

CHEP is looking for a Shift Production Manager; internally, this role is referred to as ‘Operations Supervisor Band 2’, to lead one of our manufacturing shifts at our Pontefract site. Reporting to the Operations Lead, this is a key leadership role responsible for developing Operations Supervisors, leading frontline teams, and driving operational excellence in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

This role is more than managing a shift. We're looking for someone who can combine strong leadership with data-led decision-making, using production data, KPIs, and operational analytics to improve performance, identify opportunities, and deliver sustainable results.

You'll play a critical role in developing leadership capability across the shift, creating a positive and accountable culture, and driving continuous improvement initiatives that support the site's long-term operational strategy.

If you're motivated by leading people, solving problems, and turning operational data into meaningful action, we'd love to hear from you.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Capability

  • Proven experience leading production or manufacturing teams within a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Experience leading and developing frontline leaders, including Team Leaders, Supervisors, or Shift Leaders.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing KPIs, operational metrics, and performance management processes.
  • Demonstrated experience using production data, reporting, and analytics to drive operational improvements and business decisions.
  • Experience identifying trends, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing actions that improve performance and efficiency.
  • Experience managing investigations, disciplinaries, performance management, and employee relations processes.
  • Continuous improvement and operational optimisation experience within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong Health & Safety awareness and commitment to operational excellence.

Leadership Behaviours

  • Leads through people and creates high-performing, engaged teams.
  • Uses data and facts to inform decisions, drive accountability, and influence outcomes.
  • Strong coaching mindset with a passion for developing future leaders.
  • Builds collaborative relationships and credibility across all levels of the organisation.
  • Resilient and adaptable when operating in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Positive, energetic, and able to balance people engagement with performance delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Operations Supervisors and frontline employees to improve capability and performance.
  • Drive shift performance through the analysis of production data, KPIs, trends, and operational metrics.
  • Use data-led insights to identify opportunities, solve operational challenges, and improve productivity, quality, and efficiency.
  • Lead daily, weekly, and monthly performance reviews, ensuring actions are focused on measurable outcomes.
  • Create a culture of accountability where decisions are informed by operational evidence and performance data.
  • Develop leadership capability across the shift through coaching, mentoring, and succession planning.
  • Manage employee relations matters, including investigations, disciplinaries, and performance management processes.
  • Lead continuous improvement and site optimisation initiatives that deliver tangible operational benefits.
  • Collaborate with site leadership and cross-functional teams to support strategic projects, process improvements, and operational change.
  • Maintain high standards of Health & Safety, compliance, and operational performance across the shift.

Why Join CHEP?

  • Opportunity to lead and shape a developing shift team during an exciting period of growth and transformation.
  • Significant people leadership responsibility with approximately 45 reports across a direct and indirect matrix.
  • Influence operational performance, culture, and leadership capability across the site.
  • Play a key role in improvement, optimisation, and change initiatives.
  • Long-term career development opportunities within a global supply chain and manufacturing organisation.

What's in It for You?

  • Annual bonus opportunity (Typically 10% of your base salary)

  • Share scheme
  • Flexible benefits package
  • 25 days holiday plus the option to buy and sell additional leave

Not Remote

Adaptability, Adaptability, Change Management, Coaching, Computer Literacy, Cross-Functional Work, Data Analysis, Data-Driven Decision Making, Data Literacy, Delegation, Digital Literacy, Emotional Intelligence, Feedback, Inclusive Leadership, Innovation, Inspiring Others, Learn From Mistakes, Mathematic Literacy, Mentoring, Mentorship, Motivating Teams, Prioritization, Scheduling, Stakeholder Engagement, Strategic Thinking {+ 1 more}

Strong ability to collaborate, work cross-functionally within a matrix environment and can communicate clinical product information.

title: LinC Volunteer
description:
Wellways is committed to reconciliation, lived experience and inclusivity. We strongly encourage and warmly welcome people from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, people with a lived experience of mental health and disability and people who identify as LGBTIQA+ to apply. Even if you only meet some of the criteria, we’d love to hear from you.

If you’d like to know more about our reconciliation commitment, click here Reconciliation | Wellways

About the Opportunity

The Life in Community (LinC) program is looking for volunteers with sound familiarity of the local community and a genuine interest in supporting people in their mental health recovery. LinC volunteers play an important part in supporting people to build confidence, connection and a sense of belonging within their local community.

As a LinC volunteer, you will be matched with a participant and guided by them to explore what community means in their life. Each connection looks different and is shaped by the person you are matched with. This is a role in which you can draw on your own life experiences, curiosity and compassion to support someone to engage in activities that matter to them, at their own pace and in line with their goals and interests.

A day in this role might include supporting someone to catch public transport, explore or rediscover interests and hobbies, build confidence using the internet or social networking sites, join social or interest based groups, or get to know their local area better. This could include places such as libraries, neighbourhood houses, gyms, parks, walking paths or galleries.

Meetings usually take place weekly or fortnightly for one to two hours at a time with each match spanning up to 3 months.

Please click here to download a copy of the volunteer profile to see further details relating to this role.

About Life in Community

The Life in Community volunteer program provides short term, one to one volunteer support to people who experience mental health challenges and would like support to strengthen their connection with their local community. Volunteers and participants meet in person and focus on accessible, everyday activities that support social connection and reduce isolation.

About You

We are looking for people who enjoy connecting with others and bring kindness, empathy and strong listening skills. A willingness to commit to regular catch ups, respect confidentiality, and practise self care while recognising personal limits is important. Our volunteers come from many walks of life, and we value the diversity of experience and perspective that each team member brings.

You also bring:

  • Willingness to commit to a regular volunteer schedule.
  • 100 points of identification
  • Evidence of right to work in Australia
  • Evidence of, or a willingness to undergo a National Police Records Check, NDIS Worker Screening Check and Working with Children Check
  • International Police Check required in some circumstances
    - Where this applies, volunteers are responsible for the cost of the check. A check issued within the last 12 months may be also be accepted
  • NDIS Worker Orientation Module

About Us

Wellways are a team of approximately 2000 staff and 150 volunteers across 93 sites providing a range of programs, services and supports to people right across Queensland, New South Wales, Australian Capital Territory, Victoria and Tasmania. We remain committed to our mission, of creating inclusive communities where everyone can imagine and achieve their hopes and potential; and we are always on the look-out for like-minded people who would like to be a part of this.​

For further information or a confidential discussion about this role, we encourage you to contact Lauren Dare, Volunteer Coordinator on 0447 562 247 or at ldare@wellways.org.

To apply:

Please submit a brief letter of introduction outlining your interest in joining our team and your involvement in the community.

Wellways Australia Limited is committed to the safeguarding of children and vulnerable people. All applicants applying for roles within Wellways must undergo a screening process prior to their successful appointment.

Job Description Summary

We are looking for empathetic, caring and compassionate individuals to join our team to support people in their mental health recovery and empower them on their journey to living active and fulfilling lives.

Culture

We’re passionate about our work, which is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding. All of our teams work to ensure everyone can imagine and achieve their hopes and potential. We know that people are unique and the experts on their life and are not defined by impairments, diagnosis or labels. We aim to specifically promote safety and inclusivity for LGBTIQ+ and First Nations communities.

How to Apply

This is your opportunity to join a values based, growing, innovative and nationally recognised organisation with over 2,000 staff members across 93 sites.

Please select "Apply" below to complete your application.

title: Texas Longhorns Insider
description:
Texas Longhorns Insider

The American-Statesman’s Texas Longhorns Insider doesn’t just cover the team, that person innovates on the beat. That person files news-breaking and narrative-setting FOIA requests; deftly writes game coverage, has an eye for angles other don’t see; identifies and focuses coverage on key players each season, with special attention this season on Arch Manning; sources well within the department as well as the conference and the NCAA; and picks up trending topics that resonate with readers.

What will you do?

  • Help cover Texas athletics with a focus on football, basketball and baseball, but helping in other areas as well

  • Take lead on enterprise topics and public-records reporting related to the Texas Longhorns. We expect novel reporting to come monthly in this role.

  • Monitor the junior season and Heisman chase for Arch Manning. This means sourcing up his family and closely tracking his movements, appearances and what the national media is saying about him. Lead the coverage of his story this season.

  • Mesh on-court success/happenings with off-court developments (NIL, eligibility rules, coaches compensation, etc.)

  • Build sources within Texas athletics to help break news; build sources within the SEC to help provide context to different developments or story ideas. FOIA’ing other universities is part of the job as well.

  • Write high-interest trending briefs when they arise. The insider usually takes point on in-the-moment, social-media friendly bursts.

  • Appear on camera for videos and other off-platform content; help record video to be posted on social media accounts; help build alternative story formats using our menu of “C2P” options

  • Track metrics to ensure we’re putting our efforts into areas that engage with the audience

What will it take to be successful?

  • The successful candidate will have experience and comfortability pursuing public records and source-building within athletic departments.

  • Time management skills, multitasking skills and prioritization skills under tight deadlines and communication skills will be paramount.

  • 3 or more years professional experience covering athletics

  • Experience working with different CMSes, with video and with SEO. Experience working with data sets and data visualization.

  • Strong ability to use social media and KPIs to guide decision-making on story ideas and beat coverage

  • Familiarity with a range of sports and the ability to pinch-hit on certain beats with little notice

About the Austin American-Statesman

The Austin American-Statesman (statesman.com), a division of Hearst Newspapers, is the largest newspaper in Central Texas and one of the largest in the state. title: Technical Deployment Lead, Forward Deployed Engineering - London
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.

About the Role

As a Technical Deployment Lead (TDL), you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to customers. You will own how they are built, shipped, and adopted. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals.

This is not a management role, however you'll own delivery end-to-end: embedding with customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities.

Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures).

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires deep technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid model of 3 days in office and offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent workstreams. Translate business objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

  • Run day-to-day engineering execution. Track and drive delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams. Keep progress unblocked and sequenced. Make real-time trade-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path.

  • Embed with customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption. Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan. Lead onboarding, adoption, and change management.

  • Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research workstreams land in time to support deployment goals.

  • Codify solution patterns and evals. Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models.

  • Own value cases and ROI. Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre-/post-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors.


You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring 7+ years of customer‑facing technical delivery leadership.

  • Track record of successfully leading large, complex, high-stakes customer engagements where customer outcomes depended on tight coordination and fast decision making, ideally involving AI.

  • Excel in high ambiguity environments. Know how to simplify complex and dynamic work.

  • Move fluidly between system level understanding and execution level detail; can dive into customer workflows/data, map constraints, sketch architectures and move ambiguous problems to shipped systems.

  • Think strategically and pattern-match. Able to step back from execution detail, recognise broader trends across deployments, and connect customer needs to scalable, reusable solutions.

  • Have strong technical fluency and sharp sequencing instincts. Confident discussing technical details, pressure-testing architectures, and making trade-offs.

  • Have shipped AI/LLM systems. You understand solution patterns, integration basics, and production pitfalls.

  • You’re a translator with executive presence. You make complex technical trade-offs legible to business leaders and convert strategy into day-to-day technical execution.

  • Enjoy being onsite with customers to accelerate delivery (often 25-50%, sometimes higher).

  • Have expertise in at least one major sector (e.g., healthcare, energy, financial services, semiconductors, IT) to elevate solution framing and credibility.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Relevance in ES|QL
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Developer to join the Elasticsearch - Search team. This globally-distributed team of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This technical leader is responsible for contributing to the technical direction and vision for our search capabilities, including design and implementation of new search features, enhancements to search functionality, and resolving bugs.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead initiatives within Elasticsearch to produce an industry-leading search engine offering, supplying unparalleled speed and relevance in search.

  • Contribute to Elasticsearch full time, building new search features and fixing intriguing bugs, all while making the code easier to understand. Sometimes you'll need to invent a new algorithm or data structure. Or find one and implement it. Sometimes you'll need to get close to the operating system and hardware.

  • Work with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers focused on the vector search capabilities of Elasticsearch.

  • Be an expert on Elasticsearch search relevance. You'll identify and drive improvements this area based on your questions and your instincts.

  • Work with community members from all over the world on issues and pull requests, sometimes triaging them and handing them off to other experts and sometimes handling them yourself.

  • Write idiomatic modern Java -- Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java!

What You Bring

  • Professional experience with search and vector databases, and you used HNSW, IVF, or other relevant algorithms and libraries on search platforms at scale.

  • You have solid skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as other features like lambdas.

  • You work with a high level of autonomy and are able to take on projects and guide them from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with other engineers to develop needed components.

  • You're comfortable developing collaboratively. Giving and receiving feedback on code and approaches and APIs is hard! Bonus points if you've collaborated over the internet because that's harder. Double bonus points for asynchronous collaboration over the internet. That's even harder, but we do it anyway because it's the best way we know how to build software.

  • You've used several data storage technologies like Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra and have some idea how they work and why they work that way.

  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.

  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities

  • You work autonomously and can drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • You've built things with Elasticsearch before.

  • You've worked with open source projects and are familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.

  • Experience with data storage technology.

  • You have experience designing, leading, and owning cross-functional initiatives.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

€80.400—€127.200 EUR

Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

title: AI Data Architect
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. The Role

Your role:


The ideal candidate will define and lead the target-state AI data architecture across all lifecycle stages—from initial transition and Day 1 operations to ongoing BAU support and continuous optimization.   • Care about clear interfaces, maintainable systems, and practical engineering tradeoffs.

  • Take ownership of projects from design and implementation through deployment and ongoing improvement.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building backend or distributed systems.

  • Experience designing, building, or improving services, platforms, or shared infrastructure at scale.

  • Understanding of distributed systems, data storage, concurrency, asynchronous processing, or networking.

title: Sygeplejerske til vores demensafsnit – brug din faglighed tæt på beboerne.
description:
Brænder du for demensområdet, og ønsker du at være en del af et team, hvor sygepleje, helhedspleje og personcentreret omsorg går hånd i hånd?

På Søndersøhave søger vi en sygeplejerske, der ønsker at gøre en forskel for mennesker med demens – tæt på beboerne og i tæt samarbejde med kolleger. Hos os er sygeplejersken en vigtig del af helhedsplejen og deltager aktivt i den daglige pleje og omsorg. Vi ser det som en stor styrke, at du er tæt på beboerne, da det giver dig et solidt klinisk blik og en dybere forståelse for den enkelte beboers behov, trivsel og udvikling.

Vi arbejder ud fra en personcentreret tilgang, hvor mennesket altid kommer før diagnosen. Vi tager udgangspunkt i beboernes livshistorie, ressourcer og ønsker og skaber sammen rammerne for et trygt og meningsfuldt hverdagsliv.

Hverdagen på et demensafsnit kan være uforudsigelig og fagligt kompleks. Derfor søger vi en sygeplejerske, der trives med at være en del af helhedsplejen – også når beboernes behov kræver tæt sygeplejefaglig opfølgning, koordinering og tværfaglig indsats.


Om Søndersøhave:

Søndersøhave har 69 moderne plejehjemsboliger, fordelt på 4 teams, hvor det ene team, som vi søger en ny kollega til, er vores demensafdeling. Vi tror på at smil det smitter. Højt humør, humor, omsorg og godt kollegaskab er nogle af de værdier vi vægter højt i vores team. Vi prioriterer ordentlige arbejdsvilkår, med mulighed for og forventning om faglig udvikling i et motiverende arbejdsmiljø, med prioriteret kollegial sparring.

Vi arbejder med personcentreret pleje og omsorg og tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers ønsker og behov. På Søndersøhave vil vi gerne øge fagligheden og skabe gode rammer for både beboer og medarbejdere. Gentofte kommune er en lærende organisation, også helt ud på de enkelte arbejdspladser, hvorfor vi bl.a. vægter løbende kompetenceudvikling og faglig viden højt.


Dine opgaver:

Du bliver en vigtig del af vores demensafsnit, hvor du sammen med fagkoordinator og social- og sundhedsassistenter er med til at sikre høj kvalitet i beboernes pleje og behandling. Med dit kliniske blik og din sygeplejefaglige vurdering bidrager du til at koordinere komplekse forløb og skabe sammenhæng omkring den enkelte beboer. Din tætte kontakt med beboerne giver dig et værdifuldt indblik i deres behov, trivsel og udvikling. En vigtig del af din rolle bliver at bringe din faglighed i spil tæt på beboerne og i samarbejdet med teamet. Du bidrager med sparring, delegering og vidensdeling og hjælper med at sikre, at vi sammen skaber den bedste pleje og omsorg.

Du samarbejder tæt med social- og sundhedshjælpere, social- og sundhedsassistenter, plejehjemslæge, kvalitetssygeplejerske, og nærmeste leder. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes sammen, og hos os hjælper vi hinanden på tværs af fagligheder.

Dokumentation er en vigtig del af den sygeplejefaglige opgave. Vi arbejder systematisk og ensartet med dokumentation, fordi det skaber kvalitet, kontinuitet og et fælles fagligt overblik over beboernes helbred, behov og trivsel.


Vi lærer af hinanden:

Vi forventer, at du har lyst til at dele din sygepleje- og demensfaglige viden og ser det som en naturlig del af rollen at støtte og udvikle dine kolleger. Du skal have lyst til at lære fra dig, vejlede og bidrage til et miljø, hvor vi hele tiden bliver dygtigere sammen.

Samtidig får du mulighed for selv at udvikle dine kompetencer gennem faglig sparring, kurser og et tæt samarbejde med dygtige kolleger.


Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Er uddannet sygeplejerske med dansk autorisation.
  • Brænder for arbejdet med mennesker med demens og ønsker at skabe høj livskvalitet for beboerne.
  • Trives med at indgå i helhedsplejen og ser værdien i at være tæt på beboerne i hverdagen.
  • Har lyst til at bruge din sygeplejefaglighed aktivt i komplekse forløb og bidrage med kliniske vurderinger.
  • Har erfaring med ældreområdet og gerne demensområdet – men det er ikke et krav.
  • Har lyst til at dele din viden og bidrage til læring blandt kolleger, elever og studerende.
  • Trives i et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter opgaven i fællesskab.
  • Har erfaring med Nexus eller lyst til at lære systemet at kende.


Vi tilbyder:
  • Et grundigt introduktionsprogram, så du får en god start og føler dig tryg i din nye rolle.
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med tæt sparring og samarbejde med de øvrige sygeplejersker i huset.
  • Et team af nysgerrige, omsorgsfulde og engagerede kolleger, som brænder for deres arbejde, hjælper hinanden og vægter humor og højt humør i hverdagen.
  • Et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi vægter trivsel, respekt og fællesskab højt. Vi forventer, at du bidrager aktivt til det gode arbejdsmiljø – både i dit eget team og på tværs af hele Søndersøhave.
  • Tid til faglig fordybelse, dokumentation og udvikling, fordi vi tror på, at kvalitet kræver rum til refleksion og faglig sparring.
  • Løbende kurser, kompetenceudvikling og mulighed for at udvikle dig i din sygeplejefaglige karriere, f.eks. gennem:
  • Specialuddannelse i borgernær sygepleje.
  • Uddannelse som klinisk vejleder.
  • Uddannelse inden for demens.


Søndersøhave ligger tæt på Gentofte Station.

Du kan høre lidt om os ved at klikke på linket: Velkommen til Søndersøhave


Er du nysgerrig på stillingen, eller har du spørgsmål til hverdagen hos os? Så kig endelig forbi til en kop kaffe eller te og en uforpligtende snak med afdelingslederen, Sofie Sørensen.

title: Founders Associate
description:
ABOUT ZELARA

Current CRM marketing is broken. It blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders lived this problem in leading positions at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to fix it.

Zelara is an AI lifecycle marketing system that learns from every customer interaction and continuously improves how brands communicate at the individual level. Built on top of existing CRM infrastructure, it replaces static journeys and manual segmentation with a reinforcement learning engine that generates content, makes individual-level decisions, and gets smarter with every outcome.

Enterprise customers already see up to 70% significant conversion lift. We closed one of the largest pre-seed rounds in European SaaS history, are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers, and are seeing strong market pull. Now we are building the team to scale.

THE ROLE

As Founders Associate at Zelara, you will work side by side with our Co-Founders in our Berlin office. This is a high-impact, generalist role at the core of how the company operates. You will take ownership of company operations, financial planning, fundraising, and hiring — the critical building blocks that allow the founding team to focus on product and growth. You will operate with an AI-first mindset, applying technology to solve challenges and accelerate our impact. While you will contribute across the business, your core projects will be aligned with your unique strengths. We encourage candidates with strong analytical or operational backgrounds to apply, as the role will be shaped to leverage your expertise in building Zelara.

What You Will Do

  • Own company operations: structure internal processes and keep the founding team organized and focused.

  • Build and maintain financial models — forecasts, scenario planning, unit economics.

  • Lead grant and funding applications from research through submission.

  • Drive hiring end-to-end: define roles, source candidates, manage pipelines, and build the foundations of our talent strategy.

  • Develop data-driven narratives and materials to support internal reporting, investor relations, and future fundraising.

  • Over time, help translate user feedback and AI research into product insights that influence the development roadmap.

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

Your work will be dynamic and tied to the founders' priorities. No two days will be the same. You will solve every task with an AI-first approach. One day you might build a financial scenario model for a board discussion. The next, you could be drafting a grant application, structuring an interview process for a key hire, or preparing materials for an investor update.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

30 Days (Immersion): You will immerse yourself in Zelara's product, technology, and market. You will learn about our customers, support the founding team in daily operations, and take ownership of your first key project.

60 Days (Ownership): You will own significant projects from start to finish — whether that is building a financial model, driving a hiring process, or structuring a funding application. You will contribute directly to major workstreams across operations and finance.

90 Days (Impact): You will operate with full autonomy as a strategic partner to the founders. You will proactively identify opportunities, use data to propose solutions, and drive initiatives that shape the company's direction.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have an AI-first mindset, constantly seeking ways to leverage technology.

  • You have experience in a high-performance environment, such as a technology startup, venture capital, or management consulting.

  • You have demonstrated analytical ability through activities such as building financial models, conducting market sizing, or using data to drive business decisions.

  • You have a track record of navigating ambiguity and delivering results on complex projects with minimal guidance.

  • You are an effective communicator who can convey complex ideas clearly and concisely.

  • You are fluent in both German and English.

  • You demonstrate high ownership of your work.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Direct mentorship from experienced founders who have successfully built and sold AI-driven SaaS businesses and have firsthand experience with our customers' challenges from their leadership roles at global B2C enterprises.

  • An accelerator for a future founder or C-level operator, with a clear development path toward a leadership position as the company scales.

  • Significant autonomy and ownership of critical business initiatives from the start.

  • An AI-native work environment with a personal budget for learning and development to ensure a steep learning curve.

  • A competitive salary and a meaningful equity stake, reflecting your role as a key partner in our early growth.

  • A Deutschlandticket and a gym/fitness club membership.

HOW WE WORK

We are an AI-first team. That means more than using copilots. We embrace spec-driven workflows and AI-assisted execution across engineering and go-to-market. We adopt what makes us faster and discard what doesn't. We use data and intellectual honesty to find the best solutions — and we execute with urgency. We have no patience for process theater or mistaking activity for progress.

If you want to push the boundaries of how companies are built — not just what gets built — you will fit right in.

OUR COMPASS

We are guided by four core values:

  • Seek Truth: We ground decisions in evidence. When the facts change, we change our mind.

  • Act with Integrity: We build trust through transparency, reliability, and ownership.

  • Put Customers First: We succeed only when they succeed.

  • Accelerate Impact: We prefer speed, simplicity, and real learning over ceremony.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

LOB Overview:

Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. GIS develops the bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, identifies and addresses vulnerabilities and operates a global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents. Within GIS, Identity and Access Management (IAM) is a security discipline that enables the right individuals to access the right resources at the right times and in the right context. IAM addresses the mission-critical need to ensure appropriate access to the resources across increasingly heterogeneous technology environments, and to meet increasingly rigorous compliance requirements.

Role Description:

Reporting to the Access Controls & Segregation of Duties Leader, this role is responsible for defining, operationalizing, and modernizing enterprise access control capabilities across traditional and cloud-native environments. The role will drive the evolution of role-based, attribute-based, policy-based, and segregation of duties access control models while establishing sustainable cloud entitlement management practices that reduce risk, improve visibility, and simplify access administration across the enterprise. The role will partner closely with Architecture, Engineering, Cloud Security, IAM Service Catalogue, and Line of Business stakeholders to establish modern access models that support the Bank’s continued cloud transformation.

Responsibilities:

  • Modernize enterprise access control capabilities through automation, AI-assisted analysis, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights.

  • Drive transformation initiatives focused on cloud entitlement visibility, access intelligence, permission analytics, and access lifecycle efficiencies.

  • Establish enterprise standards for cloud role engineering, entitlement taxonomy, permission management, and cloud access model design.

  • Drive adoption of RBAC, ABAC, PBAC, and SOD controls within enterprise and cloud environments.

  • Modernize the SOD design, implementation, controls, and oversight framework and practices for sustainable risk reduction.

  • Develop sustainable approaches for governing cloud permissions, cloud identities, and cloud resource access at scale.

  • Partner with cloud engineering and architecture teams to implement scalable cloud access models while reducing entitlement sprawl and excessive permissions.

  • Operate through ambiguity, break down complex problems, and create structure where processes or accountabilities are unclear.

  • Improve role quality, entitlement quality, access profiling, and access model effectiveness across technology platforms.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual activities and simplify operational processes while strengthening risk mitigation.

  • Act as a senior advisor on cloud access controls, entitlement strategy, and access modeling.

  • Partner across IAM, Security, Technology, Product, and Line of Business teams to drive adoption of modern access control frameworks.

  • Lead complex initiatives involving cloud permissions, entitlement management, role engineering, and access risk reduction.

  • Translate technical access control concepts into actionable business outcomes for senior leadership.

  • Lead the strategy and execution of cloud access control capabilities across AWS, Azure, GCP, SaaS platforms, and emerging cloud-native technologies.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of IAM, Cybersecurity, Cloud Security, or Access Management experience.

  • Experience with Industry Standards & Framework (ISO, NIST, FFIEC, COBIT, CSA) related to Segregation of Duties (SoD).

  • Experience implementing RBAC, ABAC, PBAC, JIT, Runtime, and cloud access control frameworks within large financial services or banking organizations.

  • Experience designing and managing Cloud Permission Models & Entitlement Analytics across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

  • Experience leading enterprise-scale IAM transformation and modernization initiatives.

  • Experience partnering with Architecture, Engineering, Cloud Security, and Business stakeholders.

  • Experience using analytics, automation, and process optimization to improve security outcomes.

  • Experience implementing Automation, AI-Enabled Solutions & Workflow Optimization

  • Experience performing data analytics and design solutions using scripting (Python, R, SQL) and industry tools (Wiz, Bloodhound, Splunk, Tableau, PowerBI, Pivot Tables).

  • Experience with Microsegmentation and monitoring tools.

  • Strong understanding of Cloud & Enterprise Infrastructure Platforms & Network

  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities

Desired Qualifications:

  • Strong expertise in Cloud Access Controls & Entitlement Management

  • Deep knowledge of RBAC, ABAC, PBAC, JIT, Runtime Access Models

  • Strong proficiency in IAM Architecture, Identity Attributes & Metadata

  • Working knowledge of Authentication & Federation Technologies

  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder engagement skills

  • Demonstrated ability to influence through expertise, collaboration, and credibility

  • Industry information security certification:

  • CISSP

  • CCSP

  • CRISC

  • CISM

  • AWS Security Specialty or Azure Security Engineer

  • Azure AI Engineer Associate or AWS AI Practitioner

Key Stakeholders:

  • GIS Executive Leadership

  • IAM Governance Services

  • IAM Product, Architecture, Engineering, and Operations teams

  • LOB and technology stakeholders

  • GIS, GT, Audit, Compliance, Risk, & other control partners

description:

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”

  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world

  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America

  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

Engine team owns three components used company-wide: Workato Expression Language (our original mini-language for data transformation in recipes), Data Mapper (a new, UI-oriented mapping and format-transformation component), and Decision Engine (a rules component, currently static-only, being expanded to support formulas). The stack is a Rust core with WASM sandboxing per component, with bindings into Ruby and GO.

In this role, you will also be responsible to:

  • Design and build core language and runtime features across the Expression Language, Data Mapper, and Decision Engine.

  • Own and extend the Rust core, embedding it as a native component inside Ruby and Go services via FFI bindings.

  • Help expand Decision Engine from static rules to support formulas.

  • Contribute to WASM sandboxing so each component runs safely isolated from the others.

  • Partner closely with Product and with the AI team on what these components need to expose.

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

  • Deep, hands-on Rust experience at a systems/backend level.

  • Working competence in Go - real production ability, though not necessarily your primary language.

  • Proven experience embedding Rust as a library or native extension inside another language's runtime (e.g. Rust-in-Ruby, Rust-in-Go).

  • Strong algorithms and data-structures fundamentals (sorting, trees, data processing).

  • Comfort operating without a fixed process methodology, in a deadline-driven, cross-team environment.

  • Experience with AI-assisted workflows, particularly in system analysis and hunting for inconsistencies and corner cases.

  • Scale: Experience with systems handling millions of requests/events per day.

  • Exceptional technical writing and communication abilities for diverse audiences.

  • Experience planning phased implementations and leading complex cross-team projects.

  • Proven track record with feature flags, gradual rollouts, and zero-downtime deployments.

  • Ability to facilitate architectural decision-making and create technical roadmaps.

  • Mentorship mindset and cost analysis capabilities.

Nice to Have

  • Compiler engineering experience - a strong plus.

  • WASM/sandboxing experience (Wasmtime, Wasmer, WASI, or similar).

  • Familiarity with data-format standards/RFCs (JSON, Unicode).

  • Awareness of project-cycle practices (Scrum/waterfall) and testing discipline.

  • Community: open source contributions, conference speaking, technical writing.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
Staff Security Engineer

We’re looking for a Staff Security Engineer to join Procore’s Security Engineering team as a foundational technical leader. In this role, you won’t just be implementing security controls, you will be designing the next generation of autonomous defense. Your mission is to move Procore beyond static automation toward a self-governing, agentic security posture. You will design the high-level frameworks and orchestration layers that allow a fleet of security agents to protect our platform, data, and users with minimal human intervention.

As a Staff Security Engineer, you are a force multiplier. You will partner with Product & Technology, IT, Security Operations, and GRC to execute the long-term strategy for agentic security engineering. You will use your deep expertise in distributed systems and LLM orchestration to build robust, scalable agentic workflows that solve entire classes of security vulnerabilities permanently. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity to define the future of security engineering for a global SaaS leader - Apply today.

This position reports into the Senior Manager, Security Engineering and will be based in our Bengaluru****office.

What you’ll do:

At Procore, AI isn’t a specialized tool, it's a core competency. We expect every team member to be AI-literate, leveraging generative tools and agentic workflows to move faster and work smarter. You won’t just use AI; you’ll be building the agentic future of construction.

  • Architect the Agentic Fabric: Design and implement the multi-agent orchestration layer (using LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or custom MAS frameworks) that coordinates autonomous security tasks across the enterprise.

  • Define Agentic Identity & Governance: Solve the complex challenge of Agent Identity—designing how autonomous agents authenticate (IAM/OIDC), manage secrets, and operate within least-privilege guardrails.

  • Autonomous Vulnerability Eradication: Lead the strategy for self-healing systems, building agents that don't just find bugs, but autonomously architect, test, and deploy platform-wide refactors to eliminate vulnerability classes.

  • Secure the AI Infrastructure: Architect the enterprise-wide paved path for secure agent deployment, including high-assurance sandboxing, real-time prompt-injection firewalls, and RAG data-leakage prevention.

  • Drive the Agentic Roadmap: Design the multi-year technical strategy for shifting Procore from manual security engineering to a human-in-the-loop autonomous model.

  • Lead Complex Evaluations: Spearhead the evaluation of emerging agentic security platforms and LLM-native security tools, moving them from proof-of-concept to production at scale.

  • Advanced Threat Modeling: Build agents capable of performing dynamic, recursive threat modeling of microservices and complex cloud architectures.

  • Strategic Mentorship: Scale agentic thinking across the entire Security and Engineering organization, setting the standard for how Procore builds and secures autonomous systems. Incident Response Orchestration: Build the autonomous control orchestrator agents capable of performing initial triage, containment, and evidence preservation during high-stakes security events.

What we’re looking for:

  • Development: 6+ years of experience in hands-on technical security, with a proven track record of shipping complex, distributed software in Python or Go at a Staff level.

  • Agentic Orchestration Mastery: Deep, production-level experience with agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGPT). You understand the architecture of stateful, multi-turn agentic loops and autonomous tool-calling.

  • LLM Security Pioneer: Authoritative knowledge of AI security risks (OWASP LLM Top 10) and experience building defensive layers like Semantic Firewalls, LLM Guardrails, and EWS (Early Warning Systems) for agents.

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture (AWS/K8s) specifically as it relates to providing secure, scalable execution environments for autonomous processes.

  • Agentic Identity & Access: Proven experience building or extending IAM/IGA systems to handle non-human, autonomous entities (service mesh, workload identity, agent-specific tokens).

  • Strategic Influence: The ability to influence engineering leadership and drive the cultural shift from "scanning for bugs" to "building autonomous fixers."

  • Agentic SDLC Vision: Experience embedding AI agents into the CI/CD pipeline to automate complex reasoning tasks, moving beyond simple static/dynamic analysis.

  • Analytical Rigor: A systems-thinking approach to security, with the ability to treat prompt engineering as a rigorous logic and control-flow discipline. Communication: Exceptional ability to translate the abstract world of agentic security into concrete, actionable roadmaps for both executives and junior engineers.

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

As our System Administrator / IT Support Engineer within the Corporate IT team, you'll be the person Berlin-based Taxfixers turn to when their laptop won't cooperate, their access needs sorting, or their first day needs to feel effortless.

You'll own day-to-day IT support end to end — from resolving tickets with care and speed, to making sure every new joiner has a working laptop and the right access waiting for them on day one. You've had practical exposure to device or identity workflows such as MDM enrolment or account lifecycle management in tools like SimpleMDM, Kandji, Okta, or JumpCloud, ideally including some IAM work like user lifecycle, access groups, MFA, or SSO troubleshooting.

Comfort with everyday network and office tech troubleshooting — Wi-Fi, VPN, printers, meeting-room and video call setups — is a plus, as is experience supporting remote or hybrid teams and German language skills.

title: Optical Engineer, Digital Twin (f/m/d)
description:
Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply.

We are seeking an Optical Engineer for our Digital Twin efforts to develop, validate, and apply advanced optical and multiphysics simulation tools that form the backbone of our laser Digital Twin. As part of our Laser team, you will integrate optical and multiphysics models into a coherent, predictive framework that supports system design, optimization, and experimental validation of our laser point designs. Your work will directly reduce design risk, accelerate development cycles, and enable system-level optimization of the high-energy laser systems powering our fusion program.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain integrated optical and multiphysics simulation frameworks (optical, thermal, mechanical coupling) for Digital Twin applications

  • Model complex laser amplifier architectures, including gain media, pump geometries, and thermal effects

  • Build, integrate, and continuously refine the Digital Twin environment for system-level prediction and optimization

  • Validate simulation models against experimental data and perform sensitivity and uncertainty analysis

  • Develop reduced-order and surrogate models for efficient Digital Twin deployment

  • Collaborate with optical engineers, laser physicists, and experimental teams to translate simulation results into engineering design decisions

  • Interface with Digital Twin architects, systems engineers, and program management to ensure models meet project requirements

Who You Are

Requirements

  • Master’s or PhD in optics, computational physics, applied mathematics, or a related field

  • Strong experience in optical and multiphysics simulation of complex physical systems

  • Ability to couple multiple physical domains (optical, thermal, mechanical, fluid) into coherent system-level models

  • Solid understanding of laser and optical physics (propagation, amplification, spectral and nonlinear effects)

  • Experience in model validation, uncertainty quantification, and data-driven refinement

  • Strong programming skills in Python, MATLAB, C/C++, or similar

  • Experience with simulation tools such as COMSOL, ANSYS, Zemax, CodeV, or FRED

  • Ability to communicate complex simulation results clearly to non-specialists

  • Strong collaboration skills across interdisciplinary teams

  • Structured and analytical problem-solving approach

  • Ability to work independently while aligning with broader system goals

  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills in English

Preferred

  • Proven experience developing and maintaining Digital Twin models or equivalent system-level simulation frameworks, including data integration and validation

  • Preferred: Experience translating simulation outputs into predictive tools for system design and performance forecasting

  • Familiarity with MDO workflows (UQ, DoE, ML training) and metamodelling / surrogate techniques (ROM, Digital Twin)

  • Experience with HPC batch schedulers and automation scripts

  • Familiarity with Monte Carlo techniques

  • Interest in fusion energy, high-energy-density physics, or advanced laser technologies

  • Hands-on R&D testing experience with laser systems or optomechanical assemblies

  • Proactive approach to improving simulation workflows and methodologies

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion.   • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline, M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Nuclear Engineering or M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering would be a plus.

  • 10+ years of relevant engineering experience, with 5+ years of experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams

  • Deep knowledge of:; process engineering for plant systems, safety analysis principles, design basis development

  • Deep knowledge of nuclear reactor physic and strong expertise in processing plant systems

  • Understanding of: thermal-hydraulics, chemistry, mechanical analyses, instrumentation and control (I&C), radioactive material handling

  • Manage requirements management, configuration management, radiological protection, RAMI, Licensing, documentation and control, project scheduling

    Nice to have

  • Fusion knowledge is an advantage

  • Experience in: hydrogen processing, fusion-specific systems, advanced reactor designs, tritium handling

description:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. As our People Intelligence/Apps Technical Product Manager within the People Strategy & Insights team, you'll be a critical part of developing our agentic enablement platform and responsible for building and shipping the People applications that power how we hire, develop, and grow our team — from workforce planning tools to AI-augmented performance and org design solutions.
Reporting to our Director of People Strategy & Insights and collaborating closely with People Partners, Leaders, FP&A, IT, and AI and Platform Engineering, you'll translate complex People domain challenges into elegant, scalable products that make a real difference in how we operate.   • Develop a deep understanding of the employee as “Builder” concept, and map the requirements different parts of the organisation have to unlock the capability of Engineers and non-Engineers to ship agentic workflows.

  • You are thinking in systems, understanding the economical aspect of internal processes and products and how those can create value.

  • You have a product mindset: you manage roadmaps, prioritise ruthlessly, and deliver incremental value in fast-paced environments, all while keeping the end user's experience front and centre.

title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Backend (d/f/m)
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your challenge

As a (Senior) Software Engineer on the TaxCore team, you'll be part of a shared engineering team that serves both Taxfix and Steuerbot - one team, two brands, multiple products. Based in Berlin or Stuttgart with a flexible hybrid setup, you’ll build and evolve the core shared services that power core experiences across both brands. In close collaboration with other teams, you'll design scalable backend systems and help shape technical direction as part of a small, high-ownership team that moves fast without cutting corners. This is a role for someone who loves building things that matter - and who takes genuine pride in the craft of doing it well.

Your responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve core shared services and internal tools that power stable, intuitive user experiences for both Taxfix and Steuerbot.

  • Design and implement scalable, reliable backend systems and architecture that enable core functionality across Taxfix and Steuerbot.

  • Collaborate across teams to design, ship new features and share capabilities, working pragmatically beyond the boundaries of your immediate team.

  • Contribute to shaping the long-term technical direction of core backend services, bringing both depth of expertise and a pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset.

  • Contribute across the team’s stack, including occasional frontend work on internal tooling.

  • Take ownership, remove blockers, and help the team stay focused on what matters most.

Your profile

  • You bring strong backend engineering experience and a proven track record of building and evolving complex, scalable systems in production environments.

  • You are highly proficient in at least one modern programming language, and experience with Go is strongly preferred.

  • You have solid experience with modern software architecture concepts, including API design, databases, and cloud-based systems - and hands-on experience integrating a diverse range of third-party and internal APIs.

  • You are comfortable with containerization and DevOps concepts, with practical experience using tools like Kubernetes.

  • You care deeply about code quality - writing performant, maintainable, and elegant code is something you take genuine pride in, and you have a natural affinity for the full stack of what it takes to ship great software.

  • You are familiar with AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code, and understand how to use them thoughtfully to support better, faster engineering.

  • You’re a pragmatic, hands-on builder: someone who cuts through complexity and enjoys turning ideas into well-crafted solutions.

  • You’re collaborative, direct, and outcome-oriented, and thrive in cross-functional environments where people work closely together to solve problems.

  • German language skills are a plus, as this team works closely with Germany-specific tax logic.

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. title: Senior Data Platform Engineer (d/f/m)
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your Challenge:

Taxfix makes tax filing simple, fast, and accessible for millions of users across Europe. Behind the product sits a data platform that powers everything from business analytics and regulatory reporting to ML and AI-driven product features. We’re growing and the platform needs to grow with us.

We are looking for an experienced Data Platform Engineer to design, build, and operate the infrastructure and pipelines that make data at Taxfix reliable, compliant, and ready for AI. You will own the systems that move data from operational databases, APIs, and SaaS tools into our analytical environment and make sure that data is correct, timely, and safe to use. Your work will directly enable ML and AI-powered product experiences, self-serve analytics, and regulatory reporting.

Your Team:

The Data Platform team is part of the Data Organization, which enables everyone at Taxfix to make data-driven decisions, drive business growth, and power ML and automation in our products. Within our group we have product analysts, analytics engineers, machine learning engineers, and data engineers working across the whole company.

The platform team serves many consumers analytics, ML, product, and compliance so you can expect to join cross-functional project teams regularly, working alongside backend and frontend engineers, analysts, ML engineers, product and design. Team members are all data engineers but from different backgrounds. We rely on each other to deliver our best, grow together, share knowledge openly, and invest in personal development through mentoring and innovation.

Your Responsibilities and Decisions:

  • Contribute to and operate cloud platform infrastructure - manage GCP resources (GCS, Dataflow, Dataproc, k8s, Pub/Sub…), provision and maintain environments with Terraform and help ensure the platform is reliable, predictable, cost-efficient and scalable

  • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that capture changes from application databases, APIs, SaaS and deliver clean, analytics-ready tables to our cloud data warehouse

  • Operate and improve our orchestration layer - scheduling, retries, SLA tracking, and observability for data pipelines

  • Design data models with proper layering that handle real-world data complexity: out-of-order events, schema evolution, late arrivals, and backfills

  • Own data quality monitoring - build validation, monitoring, and alerting that catches problems before downstream consumers do

  • Implement privacy and compliance controls - anonymization, pseudonymization, access policies, and deletion propagation (GDPR right-to-be-forgotten) across raw and derived layers

  • Prepare data for ML and AI use cases - build governed, privacy-safe datasets and feature pipelines that ML engineers and data scientists can use for model training, evaluation, and production inference

  • Use AI effectively in engineering workflows - leverage AI-assisted development where it improves delivery quality and speed, and share best practices with the team

  • Build scalable AI platform capabilities - develop reusable, production-grade patterns for AI workloads (governed data access, privacy-safe telemetry, evaluation datasets, and cost/quality monitoring) that multiple teams can adopt

Your Profile:

  • 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering or a similar role (backend engineer working on data-intensive systems counts)

  • Strong Python skills for data pipeline development - you write production code, not just scripts

  • Strong SQL skills - window functions, CTEs, query optimization are second nature

  • Experience with event-driven data pipelines - CQRS, event ordering, idempotency, and the difference between initial load and incremental processing

  • Expert with Airflow - you’ve built DAGs with proper task dependencies, retries, and monitoring

Overview:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Robotics Project Manager to lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of robotics projects.   • Coordinate with engineering, software development, and operations teams to ensure project success.

  • Identify and mitigate risks, ensuring compliance with safety and industry regulations.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between clients, leadership, and technical teams.

  • Monitor project progress, conduct performance evaluations, and provide regular reports.

  • Facilitate problem-solving and drive continuous improvement within project teams.

  • Collaborate with vendors and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of components and services.

  • Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in robotics and automation.

  • Assess and communicate project status, manage escalations, and track potential risks and delays.

Qualifications:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in project management within the robotics, automation, or industrial engineering sectors.

Skills

  • Exceptional communication skills; English at C2 level , German at B2 level or higher.

  • Strong understanding of robotics technologies, AI-driven automation, and system integration.

  • Experience working within a fast-paced work environment and coordinating with engineering contractors.

  • Experience working with AI-based robotics solutions.

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements for robotic systems.

  • Familiarity with programming languages (Python, C++, ROS) is a plus.

  • Comfortable shifting between detailed technical analysis and high-level strategic thinking.

  • Strong influencing skills with the ability to connect the dots at an organizational, strategic, and project level.

title: Associate, Customer Experience
description:

Quality & Consistency

Qualifications

Required
